AI 在 我 们 的 工 作 当 中 有 很 大 的 潜 力 。 刚 才 我 做 了 一 些 介 绍 。 实 际 上 的 话 ， 我 们 正 在 广 泛 地 进 行 很 多 的 新 产 品 的 开 发 和 实 验 ， 也 可 以 稍 微 再 举 点 例 子 。
[Translator]
Translator
Actually, we, yes, we do have some good progress on the AI product development side. Actually, we have been broadly to do some new product launches and development, so I can give you more examples.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
先 说 一 个 。 有 一 个 agent， 有 个 智能体 。 我 们 做 了 一 个 招 聘 的 智能体 ， 叫 做 Hammer。 现 在 的 话 ， 我 们 大 概 每 天 给 500 多个 招 聘 者 在 使 用 这 个 叫 Hammer 的 agent。 简 单 地 讲 呢 ， 招 聘 者 可 以 通 过 跟 Hammer 进 行 对 话 交 互 ， 之 后 就 完 成 大 部 分 的 一 个 招 聘 者 日 常 要 干 的 活 。
直 到 能 够 跟 求 职 者 完 成 一 次 达 成 。 这 里 面 我 们 当 然 提 醒 求 职 者 说 对 面 是 一 个 agent， 你 愿 意 继 续 吗 ？ 有 的 求 职 者 就 拒 绝 了 ， 有 的 人 愿 意 继 续 。
[Translator]
Translator
The first one is an agent. We developed a recruitment agent called Hammer. Currently, we use it with approximately 500 recruiters daily. The recruiters can complete the majority of their work on our platform by simply interacting with Hammer through dialogue. Of course, this part should have the job seekers' consent. Sometimes job seekers might say no, but if job seeker is okay, the Hammer will complete its job until to get to achieve an exchange of resume or contact information or achievement on our platform.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我 们 会 用 非 常 长 的 时 间 跟 耐 心 和 投 入 来 迭 代 Hammer。 到 现 在 为 止 ， 我 觉 得 与 其 说 这 是 在 用 一 个 新 的 技 术 方 式 来 验 证 我 们 对 recruiting industry 的 已 经 知 道 的 东 西 ， 还 不 如 说 我 们 已 经 感 到 Hammer 会 把 我 们 带 向 更 多 的 未 知 。
[Translator]
Translator
We will attach very great patience to iterate this agent Hammer. Rather than saying that we are using new technology to validate what we have already known in this industry, Hammer actually will let us into even greater unknown.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我们 在 Hammer 上 是 比较 克制 的. 另外 的 一个 例子 呢, 就是 我们 的 实验 会 比较 激进 一些. 这个 例子 有 一个 背景, 就是 求职者, 他们 的 接受度 和 忍耐度 比较 高, 而 招聘者 呢, 相对 谈判 地位 会 比较 高. 比如说 我们 为 大型 的 一些 国央企 开发 了 一套 AI 产品, 已经 上线 了.
[Translator]
Translator
Our progress on Hammer is actually quite restrained. The second one we have been more aggressive. The second example is where the job seekers have more tolerance towards this product, and the recruiters it has higher leverage in terms of the negotiation progress. It's actually a product we designed for large state-owned enterprises which have just launched.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
比 如 说 我 们 为 招 聘 者 设 置 了 digital human avatar ， 设 置 AI 控 制 的 面 试 题 目 ， 设 置 AI 来 撰 写 的 面 试 报 告 等 。 同 时 来 讲 ， 我 们 设 置 了 支 持 AI 自 主 地 进 行 追 问 ， 进 行 multi-modal 的 候 选 人 情 绪 识 别 和 形 象 识 别 等 等 能 力 。 目 前 我 们 用 这 一 套 产 品 支 持 了 over 10 家 大 型 的 国 企 ， 对 应 届 毕 业 生 开 展 了 over 20 场 的 面 试 专 场 ， 参 与 者 接 近 30,000 人 。 迄 今 为 止 的 话 ， 反 应 还 可 以 。
[Translator]
Translator
Currently, this system allows for customization of digital human avatar, interview questions, and interview reports. It also supports AI-powered follow-up questions, multi-modal candidate emotion recognition, and image recognition. Using this technology, we have supported over 20 AI-powered interview events for recent graduates at over 10 large state-owned enterprises, attracting nearly 30,000 participants, and the response has been positive so far.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
在 我 们 公 司 这 样 的 例 子 非 常 多 ， 我 相 信 在很 多 公 司 都 是 如 此 的 。 呃 ， 我 实 际 上 觉 得 AI 跟 我 们 现 有 的 产 品 技 术 、 商 业 模 式 和 公 司 的 内 部 的 管 理 相 结 合 ， 仍 然 处 在 一 个 早 期 。
我 相 信 新 的 技 术 跟 老 的 生 意 相 结 合 ， 在 相 当 长 的 时 间 里 面 ， 越 是 革 命 性 的 技 术 ， 这 种 结 合 越 体 现 为 一 种 布 朗 运 动 。 真 正 的 killer 级 的 应 用 ， 真 正 的 winner 应 该 就 是 在 大 量 的 布 朗 运 动 中 逐 步 产 生 的 。 我 们 有 这 个 耐 心 和 投 入 的 底 气 。 所 以 的 话 ， 我 们 还 可 以 在 边 走 边 看 。
[Translator]
Translator
I think that we have a lot of those examples, and that also should be quite common in many other companies. Actually, I felt that the combination of AI technology and the current products or application in technology management and daily operation is still at an early stage. The new technology combined with all the business, for this matter, the more revolutionized the product is, so that it will be more like a wrong activities movement. The killer level applications will be generated among a lot of those wrong movements. We have enough patience and we have enough assets to waiting for that kind of application to be born.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
这 个 阶 段 大 家 关 心 的 AI, 我 们 也 很 关 心, 然 后 我 觉 得 它 的 fundamental principle 就 是 把 它 当 一 个 布 朗 运 动.
[Translator]
Translator
The AI everybody cares about, we are also quite care about. The fundamental principle is just treating it like a wrong movement.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
下 一 个 阶 段 就 是 水 电 煤. 周 围 都 是 这 个 东 西. 我 觉 得 这 是 必 然 的.
[Translator]
Translator
The next stage is AI will be everything in our daily life.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
然 后 关 于 钱 的 这 个 问 题 ， 我 想 请 Phil 我 们 CFO 来 回 答 这 个 钱 的 问 题 。
Phil Yu Zhang
Executive Director and CFO, Kanzhun
I will answer the second question. As you know that the company has a very healthy cash balance on hand. We have more than CNY 16 billion cash reserve. In terms of the operating cash flow, every quarter we have, you know, incremental more than CNY 1 billion inflow. Basically the company does not need, you know, to raise money from the market. Our, you know, capital activity, our fund fundraising activity in July, the purpose of that activity is to improve our Hong Kong line liquidity. In the past, we got, you know, public listed in Hong Kong through the, you know, by introduction without issuing new shares. That made us with a very poor liquidity in our Hong Kong stock trading. We want to solve this problem.
We think that solving this problem could be, you know, both benefit to the company and benefit to our investors, to our shareholders. That's why we took a very rare approach to, you know, launch a public offering in Hong Kong. The offering was very successful, and all the participating investors all made money, and our Hong Kong line liquidity, you know, realized a breakthrough, and our liquidity started to improve since the offering. What I'm saying is that the company, we consider shareholders as our partners, and we consider the shareholder return very important topic. In the past, we mainly use shareholder repurchase program to return cash to the shareholders. We totally already, you know, launched four phases, and the total purchase shares total amount more than about $400 million.
This time the company renewed our share repurchase program and also we announced our annual dividend policy. We make this as a regular routine and make it, you know, an annual thing. Basically every year we will consider our operating situations and pay dividend to our shareholders. This year for the Fiscal Year of 2025, we announced $18 million for the dividend for this year. Our Hong Kong line, you know, liquidity, you know, because of the public share offering, we raised HKD 2.2 billion. That's roughly $280 million. Compared with our renewed share repurchase program, which is $250 million plus our $80 million annual dividend.
Our announced amount is already higher than the amount that we raised in our earlier public offering. That also showed that we had a good commitment to our shareholders' returns. One last thing related to our shareholder returns is that our share-based compensation as an expenses, we received the comments from shareholders that saying, you know, share-based compensation was once a little bit high, and we controlled these expenses. From the results, you can see that in the past several quarters, these expenses continued to decline in terms of total amount and in terms of percentage to the revenues. All above are just, you know, evidence or, you know, some kind of things that show our attitude towards the shareholders' return.
We consider this as a very important thing, and we will continue to do that in the future.
Wenbei Wang
Deputy CFO and VP, Kanzhun
Okay. That's all of our answers to today's questions, operator.
Operator
Due to time constraints, this concludes today's Q&A session. At this time, I will turn back the call to Wenbei for any additional or closing remarks.
Wenbei Wang
Deputy CFO and VP, Kanzhun
Thank you again for joining us today. If you have any further questions, please contact company interact directly. Thank you.
Operator
This concludes today's conference call. Thank you all for participating. You may now disconnect your lines. Thank you.

content.text:
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun Limited
Thank you, Peter. Good evening and good morning, everyone. Welcome to our Q1 2025 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me today are our founder, chairman, and CEO, Mr. Jonathan Peng Zhao, and our director and CFO, Mr. Phil Yu Zhang.
Before we start, we would like to remind you that today's discussion may contain forward-looking statements, which are based on management's current expectations and observations that involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors not under the company's control, which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the company to be materially different. The company cautions you not to place undue reliance on forward-looking statements and do not undertake any obligation to update this forward-looking information, except as required by law. During today's call, management will also discuss certain non-GAAP financial measures for comparison purposes only. For a definition of non-GAAP financial measures and the reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial results, please see the earnings release issued earlier today. In addition, a webcast replay of this conference call will be available on our website at ir.zhipin.com.
Now, I will turn the call to Jonathan, our founder, chairman, and CEO.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun Limited
[Foreign language] Hello everyone. Thank you for joining our company's Q1 2025 Earnings Conference Call. On behalf of the company's employees, management team, and board of directors, I would like to extend our sincere gratitude to our users, investors, and friends who have continuously believed in and supported us. [Foreign language] In response to key investor concerns, I would like to report on a few main topics. First, we have remained focused on driving profitability with encouraging results. Second, regarding the ongoing tariff war, which is a concern for many, my observation is that its impact on our business has not intensified. Third, we have continued to make solid progress on the AI front. [Foreign language] Let me start with an overview of our financial performance.
In Q1, the company achieved a GAAP revenue of RMB 1.92 billion, up 13% year-on-year. Our net income reached RMB 510 million, reflecting a 112% year-on-year growth. [Foreign language] The various uncertainties of recent years have prompted the company to formulate a strategy, which is to focus intensely on very few high-impact priorities to enhance operational certainty. Based on this, at the end of last year, we clearly proposed to guarantee profits. [Foreign language]
Excluding other income such as wealth management income, our adjusted operating income was RMB 690 million for Q1. Adjusted operating margin was 36%, up 13 percentage points year-on-year, compared to 23% the same period last year. Overall, this achievement demonstrated the company's capability to implement strategic goals and exceptional operation leverages. [Foreign language] Increasing profitability involves both cost control and revenue growth. With respect to cost, there are two things worth mentioning.
[Foreign language] First is the decrease of SBC expenses. Our share-based compensation expenses this quarter were down by 10% quarter-over-quarter. As a proportion of revenue, this represented a narrowing of nearly four percentage points year-on-year. We have previously predicted that the longer time passes since the IPO, as well as the growth of our revenue, the impact of SBC expenses on profits will decline in both absolute value and percentage. This trend will continue. [Foreign language] Second is the improvement of marketing efficiency. From January to April this year, the company added over 15 million verified new users. In Q1, the average verified monthly active users on the BOSS [Foreign language] app reached 57.56 million, up 24% year-on-year. Post-Chinese New Year, monthly active users in March approached 65 million. The average number of achievements per user continued to increase both quarter-over-quarter and year-on-year.
[Foreign language] We maintained robust user growth despite the decrease in marketing expenses, benefiting from the two-sided network effects of our model and our continued focus on improving user satisfaction. [Foreign language] Our core revenue growth drivers are still the growth of users and the increase in penetration rate. Revenue growth and user growth showed a highly correlated structural change. [Foreign language] First, blue-collar new users accounted for over 45% of our total new users in Q1, driving their shares of revenue up to more than 39%.
[Foreign language] Second, alongside with the higher growth rate of new users among Tier 3 and lower Tier cities, the revenue contribution from Tier 3 and below goes up by 3 percentage points to over 23%. [Foreign language] Third, revenue from enterprises with fewer than 100 employees hit a record high contribution for the period due to the higher growth rate of the smaller-sized companies.
[Foreign language] Many people are concerned about the impact of the tariff war. We also take it seriously. So far, our overall conclusion is, with regard to the job-seeking and recruitment supply and demand relationship, no severe impact of the war has been observed so far. [Foreign language] In general, we observed that hiring demand from enterprises has continued to show a recovery trend since Chinese New Year. From January to April, average new job postings grew 19.17% year-on-year, while the paying ratio improved sequentially, boosting total paid enterprise customers in the 12 months ended 31 March to 6.38 million, up 12% year-on-year.
[Foreign language] From industry perspective, recruitment demand for blue-collar workers represented by urban service sectors such as catering and retail has been continuously and steadily rebounding since April. Manufacturing recruitment has demonstrated resilience despite the impact of tariffs, with a number of new job postings maintaining year-on-year growth in April.
[Foreign language] Meanwhile, recruitment demand for white-collar has also stabilized and begun to recover, with industries such as advertising, professional services, Internet, finance, and automotive leading in year-on-year growth rates. [Foreign language] Since last quarter, the market has been very concerned about AI. We also attach great importance to AI in our own daily operations in the recent two years. In this quarter, in terms of products and services, we continue to deepen the application of AI technology and expand the scale and the penetration rate of AI testing users. Now, allow me to expand on our AI developments. We'll break it down into three key aspects: AI to C（to job seekers）, AI to B（recruiters）, and AI to management. [Foreign language] First, AI to C.
The first item is the grayscale testing, also known as phased rollout, we mentioned in our last earnings call, which is after a user contacts us, we do not only need to give the result, but also provide an explanation by AI why the result is what it is. Initial outcomes showed promising results, and we have now rolled it out to all users. [Foreign language] The second thing of AI to C, which we also mentioned during our last call, is our AI-powered interview robot designed to help users practice interview skills. Our experiments have shown that it can meaningfully enhance the recommendation system's understanding of individual user behaviors, and the outcome is quite significant. Now, we have officially launched it for all students and young people with up to three years of work experience. [Foreign language] Moving on to AI to recruiters.
One is the application of AI technology, which has to some extent supported our exploration in closed-loop services. The result is, in Q1, the number of enterprises we provide placement-alike services grew by about 30% quarter-over-quarter. We are now starting to see some cash-ins. [Foreign language] The other one is an agent which can interact with the users. The agent can guide enterprise users to convey their personalized recruitment demand and proactively search for suitable candidates across the platform. The agent is still evolving, we have witnessed that this agent can effectively improve the matching accuracy. Enterprise users who have used the agent see a 25% increase in achieving their recruitment results. [Foreign language] That said, we remain extremely cautious about broadly expanding the robot's role of allowing it to even somehow partially replace human recruiters. Our current strategy is as follows.
First, we place no limits on building the recruitment bot's capabilities. Second, we are extremely prudent about when and how widely we will deploy the robot. [Foreign language] Third is AI to management. Two things to talk about. First thing, the reformation of weekly reports. Now, after one finished their weekly report, we have our preparatory AI system to help create a concise summary version, which can still be revised by you. That way, you have two reports sent to your higher-up. One is the summative AI plus modified, the other one is your original version. Until now, the supervisor's behavior is trying to check the concise version first, then move on to the longer one. [Foreign language] That's just some basic applications today. How to realize the value is, the AI will study your historical weekly reports and also read across weekly reports from related departments.
If there are too many projects that are not closed loop, or the content is empty, or there are too many big words, the AI will remind you. This is a supplement to human capabilities. [Foreign language] The second thing on AI to management is the use case for talent evaluation. When we merely rely on humans for performance appraisal, even so-called 360 degrees, there might be interference from two noisy sources. [Foreign language] The first thing is forgetfulness. For example, a person's previous contributions will be done plain, and recent performance will be more important. It's quite human natural, this might not be appropriate as a long-term evaluation. [Foreign language] The second thing is also quite according to human nature. A Homo sapiens will see what others want you to see. One's superior may consciously or unconsciously filter and change their subordinates' information before presenting it upward.
[Foreign language] AI is objective. Under the premise of protecting employees' privacy and dignity, AI can see the objective changes in past performance data. AI will not like an employee because it likes his character, or will not evaluate him badly because it dislikes the employee. AI is neutral and impartial in terms of human resource applications. [Foreign language] For the AI to job seekers, to enterprise users, and to management, these three aspects, our exploration and research, are equally important. The Q1 2025 was solid. We are positive for the year ahead, and we will continue to work hard. [Foreign language] That concludes my part of the call. I will now turn it over to our CFO Phil for the review of our financials. Thank you.
Phil Yu Zhang
Director and CFO, Kanzhun Limited
Thanks, Jonathan. Hello, everyone.
Now, let me walk through the details of our financial results of Q1 2025. We are delighted to record a solid start to the year, characterized by continuous expansion in our user base and engagement and sustainable revenue growth. In this quarter, our revenues reached RMB 1.9 billion, representing a 13% year-on-year growth. We experienced a decent spring recruitment season with continuous improvements in enterprise hiring demands, evidenced by the growth of our cash collections, which has bottomed out from the last quarter. Revenues from key accounts and small-sized accounts both contributed higher growth rates in the quarter. Our paid enterprise customers grew by 12% year-on-year to 6.4 million in the trailing 12 months, ending 31 March, primarily driven by the growth of enterprise users.
Paying ratio among active enterprise users increased on a sequential basis as the supply-to-demand situation of the labor market improved from previous quarter. AR/PPU increased by 5% year-on-year, mainly due to the expansion of paying amounts from key accounts. Moving to the cost side, total operating costs and expenses decreased by 8% year-on-year to RMB 1.5 billion in Q1. Share-based compensation expenses dropped by 13% year-on-year and 10% quarter-over-quarter to RMB 252 million, shrinking for the third consecutive quarters. Excluding share-based compensation expenses, adjusted operating costs and expenses decreased by 6% year-on-year to RMB 1.2 billion, and our adjusted operating margin reached 36%, up by 13 percentage points year-on-year. A showcase of our disciplined cost control and high operating leverage, despite Q1 normally having the lowest margin within the full year due to seasonality.
Cost of revenues increased by 5% year-on-year to RMB 311 million this quarter. Gross margin went up by 1.1 percentage points to 83.8%, compared to the same period of last year, as a testimony of our AI application to improve our operating efficiency. However, our strong brand recognition enhanced marketing efficiency and superior user engagement guaranteed that we can still maintain robust user growth momentum. Sales and marketing expenses decreased by 15% year-on-year to RMB 491 million during this quarter, primarily due to decreases in advertising and marketing expenses and employee-related expenses. Our R&D expenses decreased by 9% year-on-year to RMB 424 million in this quarter, and it was relatively stable sequentially. This decrease was primarily driven by lower employee-related expenses and reduced public cloud expenses related to AI. Our G&A expenses were RMB 266 million in this quarter, remaining relatively stable both year-on-year and quarter-over-quarter.
Our net income reached RMB 512 million in this quarter, up 112% year-on-year, while adjusted net income increased by 44% to RMB 764 million. Net margin improved to 26.6%, up 12 percentage points year-on-year, while our adjusted net margin increased to 39.7%, up 8.6 percentage points year-on-year. Net cash provided by operating activities reached RMB 1.0 billion in this quarter, up 11% year-on-year. Our cash position totaled RMB 14.8 billion as of 31 March 2025. Our strong cash generation and robust cash position provide financial flexibility to execute growth initiatives and enhance shareholder returns. Now, for our business outlook, for Q2 2025, we expect our total revenues to be between RMB 2.05 billion and 2.08 billion, with a year-on-year increase of 7.0% to 8.5%.
Please note, this growth rate will also bottom out this quarter, driven by continued improvement of cash collection growth in the year. That concludes our prepared remarks. Now we would like to answer questions. Operator, please go ahead.
Operator
Thank you. We will now begin the question-and-answer session. To ask a question, please press star one one on your telephone and wait for your name to be announced. To withdraw your question, please press star one one again. We will now take our first question from the line of Eddy Wang from Morgan Stanley. Please ask your question, Eddy.
Eddy Wang
Analyst, Morgan Stanley
[Foreign language] Thank you for taking my questions. I have two questions. The first one is that would you please give us a debrief of how the hiring demand evolved over the past months from the start of the tariff war till it eases?
Have we seen any signs of the recovery in hiring demand recently? The second question is that, if I remember correctly, after May last year, micro-weakness coincided with a graduation season that has led to a deterioration of recruitment demand. How does the current recruitment demand trend in April and May compare with the same period last year? Have we seen different trends among different industries and different sizes of the enterprises? Will such trends continue into the gradual season in June and July? [Foreign language]
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun Limited
Thank you for your question. About the first one, which is tariff war, everybody is concerned. We are still looking from the supply and demand perspective of job seeker posting job expectations and recruiters post job postings. This is the most high importance to our platform.
In general speaking, the improvement, the recovery or recruitment trend is still the case. That is undoubtedly. [Foreign language] The view we talked during our prepared remarks, which is quite serious, that in general speaking, the tariff war impact on our overall supply and demand relationship is still quite limited. [Foreign language] Objectively speaking, we have a quite diversified industry and location distribution. The export-related industries, both in terms of revenue and numbers of job posting contributions, are quite low. [Foreign language] If we look at detailed numbers, for example, in April and May, the total number of new job postings and active job postings have kept a good growth rate. We haven't seen any significant fallback compared to March.
[Foreign language] For industries which affected bigger by the tariffs, such as export-related jobs, We saw some slowing in terms of growth rate in the beginning of April. It has recovered after mid-May. [Foreign language] The second question regarding the overall recruitment market. The overall supply and demand relationship has continued to improve in this year. Let's take a detailed look of the days after May compared to the same days after the spring festival. This year, we saw better growth trend compared to last year after May, especially after Labor Day holiday and after spring festival. [Foreign language]. Let's look at some detailed numbers. Since April till today, the number of newly posted jobs and the number of recruiters who posted jobs, the number, the sequential trend are better compared to last year.
[Foreign language] Among which the blue-collar sector, especially urban service blue-collar sector, the year-on-year growth rate continued to enlarge from March to May. [Foreign language] About our prediction for June and July, the graduation season, it's hard to say we can predict precisely, but according to my personal feelings, it could be okay since it's coming. [Foreign language]. That's my answer to your question, Eddy. Operator, let's move on to the next one. Thank you.
Operator
Next question comes from the line of Timothy Zhao from Goldman Sachs. Please go ahead, Timothy.
Timothy Zhao
Equity Research Analyst, Goldman Sachs
[Foreign language] Thank you, Megan, for taking my questions. Two questions here from my side. First, we understand that the company has been internally testing the AI features for both enterprises and job seekers. Could Megan share what is the feedback so far and what is the plan for the company to launch the AI monetization features?
Secondly, considering the latest macro environment, as well as the monetization rate, as well as user growth, just wondering how does Megan see the CNY 3 billion non-GAAP operating profit target for this year? Into the second half, what are our leverage to make sure this CNY 3 billion target is achievable? What is the longer-term market expansion, I think, role for the company? Additionally, could Megan share about our plan for capital allocation? Thank you.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun Limited
[Foreign language] Thank you for your question. I will take the first one regarding AI, and our CFO will answer the second question regarding the margin. About AI, is it good to summarize that our series of phased-out AI product testing has quite positive feedbacks, we have just mentioned? This is based on that we have continued to be very cautious in terms of using AI.
I think analysts and investors who are familiar with us know our views. [Foreign language] We just mentioned that some of our testing products have already opened to all of our users. It's a gradual process. [Foreign language] Regarding the monetization, I would like to share two data with you. [Foreign language] For the recruiters who have grayscaled used our AI equipment function, his efficiency of achievement increased by 25% under the same amount of conversations. [Foreign language] The AI communication assistant have accumulatively served over 9 million conversations during our massive grayscale test. The job seekers who have been responded by the AI communication assistant, his achievement rate increased by 15%. [Foreign language] In principle, the AI products can improve the efficiency, increase your user experience, and save you some time. In reality, we are still quite cautious.
My view is we might be relatively gradually and slowly on the AI adoption of monetization, but it must be some real money. [Foreign language] I'd like to answer the profitability and margin question. As Jonathan mentioned in the prepared remarks earlier, even under current conditions with many external uncertainties, the company's overarching goal for this year is to secure a solid bottom-line growth first, then try our best to grow faster with our business. In Q1, we had a good start, and we managed to reduce cost to improve overall efficiency for most of the cost and expenses items. Our marketing fees dropped in absolute amount versus last year, but we still achieved satisfactory new user growth. We had higher revenue, but our sales guys, number of our sales dropped. Headcounts for R&D, administrative costs, and operation functions kept stable.
Our internal AI tools kicked in for the platform's operation and verification jobs, which leads to improvement of our gross margin. You should know that our margin in Q1 is the lowest due to the seasonality. With all the measures mentioned above, there's still room to improve in Q2, second half of the year. We are confident with our RMB 3 billion non-GAAP operating profit target for the full year. This is the comment for the profitability and margin. Regarding the shareholder return topic, the company currently has more than $2 billion cash and equivalents on hand. We consider shareholder returns a very important topic, and we like to do whatever feeds us. Currently, our share repurchase program is still ongoing, and we definitely will continue.
At the same time, we are studying and doing some assessments for other means, other measures to increase our shareholder return. Please stay tuned. We would like to do it step by step. Okay. That's our answer to those two questions. Operator, let's move on to the next one.
Operator
Thank you. Next question comes from Wei Xiong from UBS. Please ask your question, Wei.
Wei Xiong
Equity Research Analyst, UBS
[Foreign language] Thank you, Megan, for taking my question. First, with the wider adoption of AI in the human resources industry, are we seeing any changes or expecting any potential changes in the competitive landscape? Can we leverage AI to actually further expand our service offerings? Secondly, could management share more updates regarding our blue-collar recruiting business? What are the key KPIs for this year, and how is our progress in the new business such as placement services? Thank you.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun Limited
[Foreign language] About your first question of how AI will impact the competitive landscape, my view is relatively conservative. My assessment is for this generation of AI technology and all the AI applications we can observe from the market, we haven't seen any revolutionary or disruptive changes. The competitive landscape is relatively stable. [Foreign language] I also have some predictions that. Deep globally amongst the human resource industries, there is a new generation of AI products that can change the overall landscape, then there must be pushed by the new generation of AI technology, which may be like the 1.5 or 2.0 generation. [Foreign language] Even though we haven't observed any revolutionary changes in the industries, we still place very high importance on AI and AI-related investment.
For example, last year, actually since 2023, we have bought more than CNY 1 billion of chips, which is enough for us to conduct self-developed research and small-scale inference. [Foreign language] In terms of AI science, we still maintain a small-scale lab for us to be able to conduct pre-training of our own model and replicate all those open-source models. [Foreign language] In fact, we are actually quite confident that in terms of using AI science for AI applications, our business scenario is actually quite suitable to applicate the power of AI, for AI to have some effects on our business. [Foreign language] Compared to the first emergence of ChatGPT, when we felt a little bit panic or curious at that time, now we have more certainty on the AI technology can actually help with our business and with more real feelings.
[Foreign language] More topic view to share that a lot of online recruitment platforms have long been pursuing the closed-loop or placement service. Now, with the help of AI technology, we have more certainty to confirm whether we can achieve closed-loop service in a big scale or not. [Foreign language] With blue-collar sector, new user contribution more than 45%, revenue contribution more than 39%, and increased revenue contribution from 3rd-tier and below cities. This aspect actually is becoming more and more important for our daily operations. [Foreign language] If we want one word to summarize our future efforts to serve the blue-collar and the lower-tier city users, is our service and products will be more simple and clear. [Foreign language] In terms of placement business, especially on the blue-collar placement, we have been spending a lot of resources and time.
The key point is to guarantee the efficiency and the reliability of your results. If AI application can really help with those two aspects, then we do feel some confidence in this prospect. That's why we want to further invest in this area. [Foreign language] That's my answer to your question.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun Limited
Operator, I think that's the last one due to the time constraint.
Operator
Thank you. Yes. Due to time constraint, that concludes today's question and answer session. At this time, I'll turn the conference back to Wenbei for any additional or closing remarks.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun Limited
Thank you, Operator. Thank you, everyone, for joining our call today. If you have any further questions, please contact our AI team directly or TPG. Congratulations. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you for your participation in today's conference. This does conclude the program. You may now disconnect your lines.

content.text:
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for standing by, and welcome to the Kanzhun Limited Q3 2024 Financial Results Conference Call. At this time, all participants are in listen-only mode. After the speaker's presentation, there'll be a Q&A session. Today's conference is being recorded. At this time, I'd like to turn the conference over to Ms. Wenbei Wang, Head of Investor Relations. Please go ahead, ma'am.
[Translator]
Translator
Thank you, operator. Good evening and good morning, everyone. Welcome to our Q3 2024 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me today are our founder, chairman, and CEO, Mr. Jonathan Peng Zhao, and our director and CFO, Mr. Xu Zhang. Before we start, we would like to remind you that today's discussion may contain forward-looking statements, which are based on management's current expectations and observations that involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors not under the company's control, which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the company to be materially different. The company cautions you not to place undue reliance on forward-looking statements and does not undertake any obligation to update this forward-looking information, except as required by law. During today's call, management will also discuss certain non-GAAP financial measures for comparison purposes only.
For a definition of non-GAAP financial measures and the reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial results, please see the earnings release issued earlier today. In addition, a webcast replay of this conference call will be available on our website at ir.zhipin.com. With that, I will now turn the call to Jonathan, our founder, chairman, and CEO. Hello, everyone. Thank you for joining our company's Third Quarter 2024 Earnings Conference Call. On behalf of the company's employees, management team, and board of directors, I would like to extend our sincere gratitude to our users and investors who have continuously believed in us and supported us. Let's talk about financial numbers for this quarter first. The company achieved a revenue of CNY 1.91 billion, up 19% year-over-year, and a net income of CNY 460 million.
Additionally, our adjusted operating income, which excludes share-based compensation expenses, reached RMB 610 million, reflecting a 10% year-on-year growth. During Q3, which coincided with the Olympic Games and UEFA Euro 2024, the company allocated additional resources to brand promotion, which led to an increase in marketing expenses. It was a one-off expenditure. Our annual profit growth target remains firmly on track. Additionally, it is worth mentioning that as a company listed on Nasdaq for three and a half years, and with a secondary primary listing on Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited for two years, our share-based compensation expenses, which have historically accounted for a relatively high proportion of our revenue, have entered the anticipated phase of gradual reduction. In this quarter, these expenses demonstrated a decline both on a year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter basis.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
回顾三季度的工作，两句话可以基本概括。三季度整体招聘市场环境并不轻松。公司聚焦增长引擎做功仍然有效果。
[Translator]
Translator
Reflecting on Q3, our efforts can be summarized into two sentences. While the overall recruitment market environment remained challenging, the company's unwavering focus on key growth drivers continued to yield positive results.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
具体说一下三季度的几件事情。首先，用户增长依然强劲。大家都知道，用户增长一直是我们重要的增长引擎。
[Translator]
Translator
Now let's take a look at a few notable highlights from Q3. First, our user growth continued to demonstrate strong growth momentum. As we all know, user growth has always been an important growth driver for us.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
三季度公司APP端平均月活用户规模为5,800万，同比增长30%。2024年1月到9月累计的新增在线用户超过4,000万。
Wei Zhang
Equity Research Analyst, UBS
In this quarter, the average monthly active users on our BOSS Zhipin app reached 58 million, representing a 30% year-on-year increase. From January to September 2024, newly added verified users exceeded 40 million.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
与求职者侧相比，在企业侧的招聘需求增长稍弱，但是仍然保持了增长的态势。三季度新增发布职位数同比增长18%，这主要得益于我们相对高效的业务模式带来的用户增长以及市场份额的提升。
[Translator]
Translator
Compared to the job seeker side, recruitment demand from enterprises showed a more moderate but steady upward trajectory. The number of newly posted job postings in Q3 increased by 18% year-on-year. This growth is mainly driven by the user growth and market share expansion fueled by our relatively efficient business model.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
三季度的第二件事情说一下。短期付费率受供求影响，提升速度放缓。企业留存的情况良好。付费企业客户数的增长还可以。
[Translator]
Translator
The second thing in the Q3, the growth of short-term paying ratio affected by supply and demand has been slowed down. Despite this, the retention of enterprise user remains solid, and the number of paid enterprise customers experienced a decent growth.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
七月到九月，求职者相对于招聘者的比例持续了二季度以来较高的走势，与去年同期的差距持续拉大。相对更多的求职者使得企业招人的周期变短。也就是说，企业要找到人填补一个岗位的空缺，时间相对变短。那么在短期之内，会在一定程度上影响到企业付费的欲望，这使得公司付费率的提升有所放缓。
[Translator]
Translator
From July to September, the ratio of job seeker to enterprise users continued its upward trend since Q2, with the gap compared to the same period last year continuing to widen. Relatively more job seekers have shortened the recruitment cycle for enterprises. That is, the time it takes for enterprises to fill a vacant position is reduced. In the short term, this may affect the enterprise users' willingness to pay, leading to a slower growth of the company's paying ratio.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
但是我们观察到在企业端的留存度依然保持良好。长期来看，这肯定是个好消息。各位研究企业服务的投资人和分析师都容易了解到，在年度付费企业客户达到数百万的时候，企业客户的存留情况是决定性的，是一切增长的前提。
[Translator]
Translator
However, we have observed that the retention rate on enterprise side remains solid. This is definitely a good news in the long term. Investors and analysts who focus on enterprise service market should have recognized that when the number of annual paying enterprise customers reaches a scale of millions, the retention of enterprise customers become decisive, and it is a prerequisite for sustained growth.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
截止到2024年9月30日，公司在过去十二个月的付费企业端的客户数为600万左右，同比增长22%。
[Translator]
Translator
The total number of paid enterprise customers for the 12 months ended 30 September 2024 reached around 6 million, up 22% year-on-year.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
三季度的第三件事情就是说一下企业的付费金额，也就是ARPU，基本保持平稳。
[Translator]
Translator
The third thing, that is, the average revenue per paid enterprise customers, namely ARPU, has remained stable.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
第四件事情说一下我们在蓝领制造业领域，一边坚持净化市场环境，一边努力地发展朋友圈，继续取得了令人满意的增长。
[Translator]
Translator
Fourth, in the blue-collar manufacturing sector, we are committed to purifying the market environment while striving to expand our friend circle and continue to achieve satisfactory growth.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
主要的做法是通过产品算法和运营能力的综合使用，尽可能地保证优质的招聘企业获得更多候选人沟通的机会。在平台上数据就体现为三季度海螺优选累计入驻企业的环比增加45%，签约金额的环比增长超过40%。作为一个结果，这也帮助我们在蓝领收入中占整个收入的比例进一步提升，超过38%。
[Translator]
Translator
Our strategy focus on providing high quality recruiting companies with greater opportunities to connect with candidates, leveraging a combination of innovative products, refined algorithms, and robust operational capabilities. In terms of data on our platform, in Q3, the accumulated number of enterprises joining Hailuo Youxuan project grew by 45% quarter-over-quarter, and signed contract value increased by over 40% quarter-over-quarter. This also helped the revenue contribution from overall blue-collar business in terms of total revenue further increase to more than 38%.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
第五，在技术上，公司持续投入，继续地创造了更大的价值。在三季度，平均每个月的达成的次数将近两亿次。招聘者和求职者的人均达成次数，也就是每个人在平台中获得的基于双方、基于双向同意的一个沟通机会，在同比上仍然保持继续上涨。
[Translator]
Translator
Fifth, the company continues to invest in technology to create greater value. In Q3, our platform facilitated an average of nearly 200 million monthly mutual achievements, demonstrating a continual rise in the number of successful interactions based on mutual consent between enterprise users and job seekers on a per capita basis.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我作为一个创业者，我跟我的伙伴平时都会把这组数据看作是我们公司为这个世界提供的价值的表达，这始终是我们公司长期追求的目标。
[Translator]
Translator
As an entrepreneur, I and my friends all view this data as a testament to the value of our company brings to the world, and this has always been the goal that our company will long pursue.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
最后要说一下，投资人关心的股东回报。从上个季度的业绩会到现在，公司的累计回购在大概1.3亿美金，今年的累计回购大约在2.2亿美金，对应我们总股本大约在3.4%。这体现了公司对于长期增长的信心，以及在任何情况下都要持续关注并且落实股东回报的诚意。
[Translator]
Translator
Last, regarding shareholder returns, the company has repurchased around $113 million worth of shares since our last earnings call, bringing the total repurchase for this year to approximately $220 million, representing 3.4% of our total shares. This underscores the company's confidence in our long-term growth prospects and our commitment and a concern to delivering sustained returns to shareholders in any circumstances.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我的部分就介绍到这里。接下来请我们的CFO Phil为大家介绍一下我们的财务情况。谢谢。
[Translator]
Translator
That concludes my part of the call. I will now turn it over to our CFO, Phil, for the overview of our financials. Thank you.
Phil Yu Zhang
Director and CFO, Kanzhun
Thanks, Jonathan. Hello, everyone. Now let me walk through the details of our financial results for Q3 2024. We delivered a solid set of financial results in this quarter despite the industry headwind, with revenue grew by 19% year-over-year to CNY 1.9 billion. This growth was mainly driven by the continual expansion of our enterprise user base as we further penetrated into blue-collar industries, lower-tier cities, and small-sized companies market, even facing a generally soft recruitment market. Number of paid enterprise customers was 6 million in the trailing twelve months ended 30 September 2024, up by 22% year-over-year and 2% quarter-over-quarter. ARPU in this quarter remained stable sequentially. Notably, our overall operating costs and expenses were flattish quarter-over-quarter, even including several one-off or non-recurring expense items in this period.
As one of our key focuses being sustainable cost control, we are confident that our effective business model can continue to generate strong operating leverage in the future. Looking at the detailed financial metrics, excluding share-based compensation expenses, adjusted operating costs and expenses increased by 23% year-over-year to CNY 1.3 billion, flattish quarter-over-quarter. Adjusted operating profit reached CNY 605 million, up by 10% year-over-year with adjusted operating margin of 32%. Cost of revenues increased by 17% year-over-year to CNY 314 million in this quarter, mainly driven by higher server and bandwidth costs, payment processing costs, as well as employee-related expenses. Gross margin capped at the same level of 84% as last quarter.
Sales and marketing expenses increased by 14% year-over-year to CNY 522 million in this quarter, primarily driven by the marketing campaigns launched during the Paris 2024 Olympic Games and the UEFA Euro 2024. Excluding the sponsorship expenses, we witnessed the improved efficiency and business leverage in both our selling and marketing expenses. Due to our strong brand recognition and a powerful network effect inherent in our business, we are confident that the enhanced marketing efficiency trend will continue to improve along with our top-line growth. R&D expenses increased by 12% year-over-year to CNY 464 million in this quarter. Excluding share-based compensation expenses, adjusted R&D expenses increased by 18% year-over-year to CNY 361 million.
The depreciation cost associated with our earlier investments in AI infrastructure has largely stabilized and is not expected to increase in the near future. Our G&A expenses increased by 31% year-over-year to CNY 286 million in this quarter, mainly due to higher employee-related expenses and some one-off expenditures that will now occur in the coming year. Our net income was CNY 464 million in this quarter, up 9% year-over-year. Our adjusted net income in this quarter reached CNY 739 million, and increased by 4% year-over-year, which was affected by the decrease in the interest and the investment income. Total share-based compensation expenses amounted to CNY 275 million in this quarter, down by 9% quarter-over-quarter and 5% year-over-year.
As Jonathan just mentioned, we are expecting total share-based compensation expenses to continue the downward trend in 2025. Net cash provided by operating activities in this quarter was CNY 812 million, relatively stable with that of the same period of last year. As of 30 September 2024, our cash and cash equivalents, short-term time deposits and short-term investments totaled CNY 14.6 billion. We launched a additional share repurchase program in August 2024, running concurrently with the March program, which allows us to buy back up to $350 million of shares.
Since the announcement of the August program, as Jonathan just mentioned, we have repurchased a total consideration of approximately $130 million, making the total buyback amount reach $220 million this year. Demonstrating our commitment in shareholders' returns and long-term confidence of our business. Now for our business outlook. For Q4 2024, we expect the total revenues to be between RMB 1.795 billion and 1.81 billion.
A year-over-year increase of 13.6% to 14.5%. That concludes our prepared remarks. Now we would like to answer questions. Operator, please go ahead with the queue.
Operator
Thank you. If you'd like to ask a question, please press star one one. If your question has been answered and you'd like to remove yourself from the queue, please press star one one again. Our first question comes from Eddie Wang with Morgan Stanley. Your line is open.
Eddie Wang
Equity Research Analyst, Morgan Stanley
谢谢赵总，我是文蓓，感谢接受我的提问。我这边有两个问题，第一个就是我们看到就是九月一日以来吧，政府确实出台了一系列的支持性的宏观政策，那这个对我们招聘市场恢复是否有帮助，我们是否也看到一些运营数据上的改善，来对应这个宏观支持性的政策。这是第一个问题。然后第二个就是说，可能我们看到四季度整个宏观依旧还是比较不确定，那这样的不确定可能会延续到明年吧。那在这种可能不太确定的宏观环境下，我们如何继续保持明年的收入增长？那我自己可能翻译一下。Thank you, management, for taking my question. I have two questions. The first one is that the government has launched a series of supportive policies since September.
Have you witnessed any signs of this policy has helped to both the recruitment market and, you know, operating metrics improvements as well. The second question is, given the uncertainty of the macro economy, which could, you know, sustain into 25, how should we think we could maintain the revenue growth in 25? Thank you.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
好，谢谢你的问题，我来说一下。关于九月底的一系列政策，我们看到新增的企业端的用户数在十月份之后出现同比变好。请注意，每年的十一、十二月其实是一个常见的招聘淡季，每年的十一、十二月是一个招聘淡季。那么我们新增的企业端的客户数在十月之后同比变好。我理解这是一个好消息。随之而看，十一月跟十二月，现在已经在十二月了，这个趋势目前保持住了。这是我要讲的第一个观察。
[Translator]
Translator
Thank you for your question. About the first one regarding the supporting policy since the end of September. I have several observations to share with you. First, we noticed that the newly added enterprise users every day has been improving on a year-over-year basis since the end of October. Please note that November and December are traditionally a relatively low season for recruitment. However, the newly added enterprise users improving on a year-over-year basis since October. My understanding is that this is a good news, and this trend have continued into November and December.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
其实大家都很关心这个C:B比，这个C比B，job seekers比recruiters。这个比例呢是持续在回落。我们刚才在季报里面说过，七月份到九月份那个同比是跟去年比是高的，现在的情况呢持续回落，现在的比例关系已经优于去年同期，比去年同期低，达到了今年的一个较低的水平。我个人理解，这表明在就业领域的供需失衡正在改善。从我们的数据可以看到这一点。
[Translator]
Translator
The second thing about the job seeker to recruiter ratio, which I believe many of you are concerned, has continued to fall back. I have just discussed in my prepared remarks that during July to September, that number was high compared to the same period last year, and now it is lower than the same period last year, which has reached the relatively low level within this year, which means the supply and demand imbalance issue is improving.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
虽然如此，虽然如此，我自己还是会觉得，毕竟从政策到实际经济数据上的表达，尤其具体到企业在招聘这种非常具体的事情上的表达，它一定是有一个传导的过程，所以我觉得我们在这个市场还是要冷静。
[Translator]
Translator
Even though despite this good news, good signs, my understanding is that this supporting policy needs to take some time to translate into actual improvement of economy and actual improvement of enterprise recruitment demand. This should take some time and we should stay patient and calm.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
你问到这个第二个问题，就是面对一系列的不确定性，我们如何来guarantee明年收入是增长的。这个我，我其实有这么几个看法。首先就是我们的收入增长呢，其实是有一些比较稳定的、比较明确的drivers。第一个就是用户增长，我现在看来，明年我们预期至少还是会有15%这样的一个整体的用户增长的情况。因此的话，即便是B端的增长速度可能会稍慢，但仍然我看还是一个增长的趋势。如果宏观的情况能够稳定向好，则我的B端的增长就有希望变得更好。所以的话，我觉得用户增长是我的一个看得见的driver。
[Translator]
Translator
About the second question, facing the uncertainty of macro, how we can guarantee our continued revenue growth trend. We have several key structural growth drivers for our revenue, which is still unchanged. The first thing is user growth. Even though all of these uncertainties, we expect that we can still have at least 15% overall user growth. The enterprise side might be slower, but still it can grow. If the macro can stabilize at some level, then we expect the enterprise side have better performance. Our user growth as the most important driver is still quite solid.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
然后我的一个driver，比较稳定的driver其实是付费率水平。那现在来看，有几个观点可以讲。第一个观点就是我的整个付费率的情况是从5%、10%、20%、30%、40%这样，这些年一直慢慢发展过来的。所以我的总体趋势是，我的付费率的增长的趋势是显然的。
[Translator]
Translator
The second important driver is our paying ratio can still maintain a stable level. If you're looking back, our paying ratio started at even like 0.5% and improved along these years, now reaching at like 20 to 30% level. The upward trend is unchanged.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
另外就是我们刚才提到的一个观点，就实际上，付费率水平的情况，跟求职者跟招聘者的这个供求比例的关系其实是有关的。那么随着供求比例的回暖变好，这个我们已经提到了，那么我的付费率水平其实可以在保持的情况下继续向好。
[Translator]
Translator
Another opinion is that the increase of paying ratio has some connection with the supply and demand balance. As the sign of the supply and demand balance improving, we expect that if the economy can be stabilized, then our paying ratio can return to our growth trend.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
如果宏观经济继续向好发展，那么显然综上，我的付费率水平也会有一个比较明显的增长。

In the history of the bad people fighting with the platform, the first principle is actually the fighting of the cost. Whenever the evil guys feel like to do bad things on the platform, then he will not continue to do that. With the help of AI, we can actually increase our advantages over that, so it can create real value for our operation.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
以上是我的回答。
[Translator]
Translator
That's my answer for your question. I think that's all the questions for tonight. Operator.
Operator
Thank you. Due to time constraint, that concludes today's question-answer-session. At this time, I'll return the conference back to Wenbei for any closing remarks.
[Translator]
Translator
Thank you once again for joining us today. If you have any further questions, please contact our IR team directly or ICR Investor Relations. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you for your participation. This does conclude the program. You may now disconnect. Good day.
