content.text:
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for standing by, and welcome to the Kanzhun Limited Q2 2024 Financial Results Conference Call. At this time, all participants are in listen-only mode. After the speaker's presentation, there'll be a Q&A session. Today's conference is being recorded. At this time, I would like to turn the conference over to Ms. Wenbei Wang, Head of Investor Relations. Please go ahead, ma'am.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Thank you, operator. Good evening and good morning, everyone. Welcome to our Q2 2024 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me today are our Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Mr. Jonathan Peng Zhao, and our Director and CFO, Mr. Phil Yu Zhang. Before we start, we would like to remind you that today's discussion may contain forward-looking statements which are based on management's current expectations and observations that involve unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors not under the company's control, which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the company to be materially different. The company cautions you not to place undue reliance on forward-looking statements and do not undertake any obligation to update this forward-looking information, except as required by law. During today's call, management will also discuss certain non-GAAP financial measures for comparison purpose only.
For a definition of non-GAAP financial measures and a reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial results, please see the earnings release issued earlier today. In addition, a webcast replay of this conference call will be available on our website at ir.zhipin.com. With that, I will now turn the call to Jonathan, our Founder, Chairman, and CEO. Hello, everyone. Thank you for joining our company's Q2 2024 earnings conference call. I will start with our financial numbers. In Q2, the company achieved calculated cash billings of CNY 1.95 billion, up 20% year-over-year. Our GAAP revenue reached CNY 1.92 billion, up 29% year-over-year. We recorded a net profit of CNY 420 million.
Meanwhile, our adjusted net income, which excludes share-based compensation expenses, rose to CNY 720 million, up 26% year-over-year. In Q2, the average verified MAU on the BOSS Zhipin app grew by 25% year-over-year to 54.6 million. From January to June this year, the company attracted around 28 million newly added verified users. The total paid enterprise customers in the twelve months ended 30 June 2024, reached 5.9 million, representing 31% year-over-year growth.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
这主要是由于在二季度后半段，客户侧招聘需求走弱，招聘者相对较少，求职者相对较多，也就是我们所说的C/B比高。这种情况之下，大部分的企业招人会更加容易。例如原来需要三个月才能招满一个项目团队，现在只需要两个月。企业复聘招人的欲望会下降。
[Translator]
Translator
Our cash billings in Q2 still have a decent year-on-year growth. However, weaker on a quarter-on-quarter basis and a little bit lower than our expectation. This was mainly due to weaker demand from the recruitment side in the latter half of Q2. There were relatively fewer enterprise users and more job seekers in the market, which is what we refer to as a high C/B ratio. In this case, most enterprise users found it easier to hire. For example, a project team that took three months to fill all the positions in the past now only takes two months, reducing enterprise users' desire to spend more money on recruitment.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
但是我们仍然发现招聘者的增长趋势依然不错。有两个证据。第一，二季度新增招聘者的数量是超过去年同期的。第二，二季度平均月活的招聘者同比增长了17%。长期关注我们公司的投资人都了解，用户增长是我们收入增长的重要驱动因素。我们在二季度招聘者仍然有不错的增长，对公司来说，这是一个好消息。
[Translator]
Translator
We noticed that the growth trend of enterprise users is still good. There are two proofs. First, in Q2, the number of newly added enterprise users was higher than that of the same period last year. Second, the average monthly active enterprise users increased by 17% year-over-year. Investors who have long been following us know that user growth is the core growth driver for our revenue growth. We still have a good growth of enterprise users in Q2. This is good news for the company.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我们认为二季度的表现是一个短期情况。长期看，结构性增长的机会仍然存在。我们的信心来自于三个方面。第一，中国市场是一个巨大的SME活跃度最高的企业数量最大的经济体。第二，劳动力供给不足，尤其是青年劳动力供给不足，这个趋势是不容易转变的。第三，我们高效的服务模式是最适合以上第一和第二种状况的。
[Translator]
Translator
We believe the Q2 performance is a temporary situation. Long term structural growth opportunities remain strong. Our confidence is grounded in three factors. First, the Chinese market is a huge economy with the highest small and medium-sized enterprise activeness and the largest number of enterprises. Second, there is a persistent shortage of labor supply, particularly among younger generation, which is unlikely to change in the near future. Third, our efficient service model is best suited to address the challenges presented by the first two factors.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
当前的形势下，公司管理层认为我们要做适合这个时候该做的事。今天主要讲三件事。
[Translator]
Translator
Under current situation, the company's management team believe we should do what is best suited for the moment. Today, I will talk about three things.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
第一件事，全年的利润要能够保证实现。在遇到困难的时候，不论投资人还是公司的核心员工，还是潜在的投资人和潜在的人才，都有一个信心的问题。在遇到困难的时候，信心比黄金还要珍贵。保证全年的利润，有利于大家保持对公司的信心，而且是完全可以通过进一步的精细化管理得以实现的。
[Translator]
Translator
The first thing is to ensure the full year profit target. During challenging times, confidence is crucial for everyone, no matter co-investors, core employees, or potential investors, and the prospective talent. In tough times, confidence is more valuable than gold. Ensuring profitability for the year will help to sustain confidence in the company, which can be achieved through further refinement of our management.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
第二件事就是投入更多资源在新的增长点上。比如说在蓝领制造业上有一些新的dollars可以找到。
[Translator]
Translator
The second thing is to invest more resources on new growth driver. For example, in the blue-collar manufacturing industry, there may be some new dollars.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
简要回顾一下我们谈过几次的蓝领制造业。背景是由于工厂、工人、平台、中介四方复杂的关系，以及在历史上遗留下来的很多因素，互联网平台服务于蓝领制造业的道路很艰难。
[Translator]
Translator
To briefly review the blue-collar manufacturing industry we had talked before. The background is the complex relationship between factories, workers, platforms, and agents, in addition to many historical issues, have made it challenging for online platforms to serve the blue-collar manufacturing industry.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
历史是三年前，我们从净化求职招聘环境开始做，也就是海螺计划。这个计划的初衷有两个：一，让求职者的求职过程受到保护。第二，让蓝领经纪人、中介组织能够体面地赚钱。
[Translator]
Translator
The history is three years ago, we started by purifying the job-seeking and recruitment environment through what we called the Conch Project, Hailuo. The original intention of this initiative has two. First is to protect the overall job-seeking process of the job seeker. Second was to help blue-collar agents and organizations make money decently.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
现状是这样的，经过艰苦的博弈，目前这个领域的中介组织在互联网平台上长期的劣币驱逐良币的局面开始出现了转变。目前已经实现了这样的事情，一批要承诺诚信对待求职者，并且如实发布职位内容，并且如实发布职位薪资的好人，可以获得较好的效果。我们给这部分中介组织一个命名，叫做经过平台认证的海螺优选。
[Translator]
Translator
The current situation is after a tough game, the long-standing issue of bad or low-quality agents driving out good ones across online recruitment platforms is beginning to improve. This positive shift has already happened. Good guys who commit to treating job seekers with integrity, posting authentic job details and salary information are now receiving better results. We have named these trustworthy agents as platform-certified Conch Select.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
最新的数据是海螺优选在二季度的收入是四千多万人民币，比一季度有了较大的增长。这个好的迹象让我感到几年来我们的策略和坚持是对的。
[Translator]
Translator
The latest data is our Conch Select project generated over CNY 40 million in revenue in Q2, which is much higher than that in Q1. These good signs make me feel that our strategy and the persistence in the past few years are correct.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
第三件事就是海外业务发展。众所周知，经济是有周期性的，很多时候不同国家跟地区的经济周期是错峰错步的。许多在全球有良好布局的大型企业，有效地利用这种地域性的周期错峰，是可以有利于可持续发展的。特别是BOSS直聘在全球首创了当前的模式，这个模式极有可能通过本地化，通过某种杂交和进化的过程，在不同的区域市场提供价值，获得生存和发展的空间。目前公司在欧洲跟亚洲的进展更为明确，但还不到可以汇报成绩的时候。
[Translator]
Translator
The third thing is our overseas business. As we all know, economies are cyclical, and these economy cycles are often out of sync across different countries and regions. Large companies with a strong global presence can effectively utilize this regional peak shift to support sustainable growth. In particular, BOSS Zhipin has pioneered our current model globally. This model is very likely to provide value and gain space for survival and development in various regional markets through localization, hybridization, and evolution. While we are seeing promising progress in Europe and Asia, it's still too early to report out results.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
最后还是要说一下信心的事情。为了增强信心，增强我们的核心投资人对公司的信心，现在是一个要加强对上市以来一直支持我们、信任我们的股东的回报的时候。例如说我们加大力度积极回购，过去四个月累计回购8,800万美元。这都有利于增强股东和管理层的信心。
[Translator]
Translator
Last but not least, it's important to address confidence again, particularly in terms of strengthening the returns for our shareholders who have constantly supported us since our IPO. For example, we will continue to increase our share buyback efforts. We have repurchased over $88 million in the past four months. This all will help to reinforce the valuable confidence of our shareholders and management.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我的部分就介绍到这里，接下来由我们的CFO Phil为大家介绍我们的财务情况。谢谢。
[Translator]
Translator
That concludes my part of the call. I will now turn it over to our CFO, Phil, for the overview of our financials. Thank you.
Phil Yu Zhang
CFO, Kanzhun
Thanks, Jonathan. Hello, everyone. Now let me walk you through the details of our financial results of Q2 2024. In this quarter, we delivered a healthy and sustainable top line and bottom line growth. Calculated cash billings and revenues grew by 20% and 29% year-over-year respectively, mainly driven by the growth of our enterprise users. Average monthly active enterprise users in the quarter grew by 17% year-over-year. We continued to penetrate into different categories of users, especially in blue-collar sectors, small- and medium-sized enterprises, and users from lower-tier cities. As a result, revenue contributions from those sectors continued to increase. Paid enterprise customers in the 12 months ended 30 June 2024 increased by 31% year-over-year to 5.9 million. The paying ratio was higher than last year, but sequentially kept stable.
We are happy to see that ARPPU average paying, per paying user, of paid users increased around 3% year-on-year and 3% sequentially, reaching the highest level in the past Q4. Part of the reason was that revenue from key accounts outgrew small and middle-sized accounts. More importantly was our effort to increase client usage by offering high quality and targeted products and services. Moving to the cost and expenses side. Excluding share-based compensations, adjusted operating cost and expenses increased by 20% year-on-year to CNY 1.3 billion, and that led to an adjusted operating profit of CNY 660 million in the quarter, up 52% year-on-year. Adjusted operating margin reached 34.4%, up by 5.3 percentage points compared to the same quarter last year, and hit an all-time high.
Cost of revenues increased by 17% year-over-year to RMB 317 million in this quarter, representing a gross margin of 83.5%, continued its upward trend. Sales and marketing expenses increased by 16% year-over-year to RMB 545 million in this quarter. This increase was mainly driven by our enhanced investment in customer acquisition, as well as higher sales commissions. R&D expenses increased by 21% year-over-year to RMB 444 million in this quarter. Excluding share-based compensation expenses, adjusted R&D expenses increased by 28% year-over-year to RMB 334 million. This increase was primarily driven by our earlier investments in AI infrastructure, which generated a higher depreciation cost.
Our G&A expenses increased by 29% year-over-year to RMB 261 million in this quarter. Adjusted G&A expenses increased by 21% year-over-year to RMB 153 million, mainly due to increased employee-related expenses. Our net income was RMB 417 million in this quarter, up 35% year-over-year. Our adjusted net income in this quarter reached RMB 719 million, an increase by 26% year-over-year. We expect that our share-based compensation expenses reached the peak level in this quarter and will gradually decline in the coming quarters. We are now reviewing stock compensation scheme and studying some schemes which might even accelerate the process.
Net cash provided by the operating activities grew by 14% year-on-year to CNY 869 million for this quarter. As of 30 June 2024, our cash and cash equivalents, short-term time deposits, and short-term investments totaled CNY 14.3 billion. Notably, in the past four months, we have repurchased a total consideration of $88 million, which demonstrated our commitment to shareholders' return and long-term confidence in our business. Now for our business outlook. For Q3 2024, we expect our total revenues to be between CNY 1.9 billion and 1.92 billion, a year-on-year increase of 18.2% to 19.5%. That concludes our prepared remarks, and we would like to answer questions. Operator, please go ahead with the queue.
Operator
Thank you. If you'd like to ask a question, please press star one one. If your question has been answered and you'd like to remove yourself from the queue, please press star one one again. One moment for questions. Our first question comes from Timothy Zhao with Goldman Sachs. Your line is open.
Timothy Zhao
Equity Research Analyst, Goldman Sachs
赵总与各位，感谢接受我的提问。那我这边有两条问题，第一个是关于我们的用户增长，那我们看到在公司的prepared remarks里面也有讲到，我们的用户增长还是非常不错的。那想请教一下管理层对于现在的市场竞争格局怎么看？那在整个宏观可能受到压力的情况下面，那我们会如何考虑去加大我们增长市场份额的这个力度？这是第一条问题。那第二条问题是我们也刚刚提到，要今年保证全年的利润额，那这个具体我们有哪些措施来保证今年的利润？那如何看待今年下半年的利润率和包括这个SBC的这个趋势？那我很快翻译一下。Thank you very much for taking my question.
I have two questions here. The first is regarding your user growth and market share. How does management team view the market share currently, and in the adverse macro environment currently, are we considering to further accelerate the market share again? Second, as we mentioned, to ensure the full year profit this year, could management share what is your detailed measures and what is your OPEX including the SBC trend for the rest of this year. Thank you.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
好，我来说一下，就是公司目前在国内市场的竞争格局是比较稳定的，或者也可以说公司的竞争优势是比较明显的。大家从很多第三方数据是能够得到一些验证，我们自己播报的数据也是如此。
[Translator]
Translator
Okay, thank you for your question. For the first one regarding our competition. The current competitive landscape is relatively stable, or we'd rather say we have a relatively good competitive advantages. There are many third-party data that our own data can prove that.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我们在平台的MAU数据刚才说过了，然后DAU的数据的话，我们也是获得了历史新高这样一个水平。活跃度的话，实际上大家也可以看到平台的DAU跟MAU之间的比例关系，这个一直保持了一个比较好的关系。用户的使用时长等等也是如此。综述的话，作为一个国内领先的互联网招聘平台，在各个维度看来，在竞争格局中保持了稳定并且持续良好的态势。
[Translator]
Translator
For example, we just mentioned, our MAU and DAU all achieved a historical high in Q2. The user activities, for example, the DAU and MAU ratio still remain at a very high level. The same case for the user usage time. All of those data prove that as a leading online recruitment platform on every perspective, our competitive landscape is relatively stable and continued in a good trend.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
从这个今年能够确保利润来讲，我觉得首先是公司的核心员工、管理层在今天这样的情况下，大家有一个一定要做到的目标，这个目标本身也是信心的一部分，就是说这个公司是结实的。那么从大的策略上来讲，我觉得可以简单地这么来看。首先来讲，就是在这样一个情况下，我们全年4,000到4,500万的一个用户增长目标，我们实际上在上半年一到六月份已经实现了大部分，2,800万。所以我们今年的用户增长目标还剩1,200到1,700万这样的水平，这就给我们的市场费用的控制有了很大的余地。这是一个方面，我们还是可以确保我们全年用户增长目标的实现。第二点来讲，就是在目前的情况下，公司在资源分配上适当地将一些胜算较低但是赔率较高、短期看有一些消耗性的目标适当地向后放一放，不是不做了，而是要看时机。另外就是说在工作的紧急度上，我们也可以适当地将一些降本的工作紧急度下调。综上，我们可以通过内部管理的方法，较大程度上能够实现，并且有更强的确定性来实现全年利润目标。具体的数据的话，我觉得Phil可以说一下具体一些细节。
[Translator]
Translator
In terms of guaranteeing the full-year profit target. We believe it's very critical for our core employees, for our management to have this target. This is part of our confidence and is a test of whether this firm is very stable and strong. On a strategic perspective, the first way is our full-year user growth target is 40 to 45 million. In the first six months, the H1 of this year, we have already achieved 28 million. There are only 12 to 17 million left for us to grow. It should be relatively easy to achieve so we can control our overall spending on marketing to appropriately achieve our profit target.
Second, under current circumstances, we want to better use our resources and to move the priority of those project initiatives with lower success rate and higher target, to postpone its resource usage, and prioritize the importance of reducing the overall cost. This can be achieved through internal management. We believe with very high level proficiency. In terms of detailed data, I think Phil can give you some more color.
Phil Yu Zhang
CFO, Kanzhun
Regarding our bottom line and the major cause and the expenses item, I'll quickly mention our thoughts. As Jonathan Peng Zhao just mentioned, we would like to try our best to secure our operating profit. Our target for full-year non-GAAP operating profit is set as CNY 2.3 billion, which is roughly up 40% year-over-year on top of last year's adjusted non-GAAP operating profit. In terms of our gross margin, our gross margin will in Q3 or following quarters stay flat or slightly improve due to higher economies of scale. Our marketing expenses, as Jonathan Peng Zhao mentioned, will be controlled and at a relatively low level.
Our selling expenses and the G&A expenses, those expenses items, will all be moderate and in a reasonable situation. In terms of the R&D expenses, because of, we probably will shift our priority from some like AI related infrastructure investments into other things. From Q3 or from second half, this part, the expenses will decrease. Altogether, our operating margin will increase second half and, versus the full year operating margins versus last year, will also be better. Thank you.
[Translator]
Translator
And-
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
就是您提到这个，包括其实非常多的我们投资人也会关心一件事，就是因为刚才提到这个市场份额，我们的很多投资人也关心这个情况下，我们会不会比较激进地去增加这个市场份额。实际上，这几年来，我们一起经历了这么多，对公司的这个模式来说，其实当前我们如果花一块钱的话，确确实实会带来更多的C和更少的B。而目前实际上C/B比实际上是我们这个双边供需关系的平衡的情况下的这个服务平台面临的一个挑战。所以的话，从这个意义上来讲，要保持好招聘者和求职者这个生态平衡的话，我们实际上是不宜更加激进地去花钱，这个实际上是要跟大家说一下的一个观点。此外的话，在B端的话，如果要增加我们的份额，目前来看，因为大家这个招聘者的付费招聘欲望普遍相对低，在这个情况下，如果在B端扩大份额的有效方法应该就是打价格战。说实话，我觉得我自己是不打算这么做的，可能现在这个时机，可能是一个时机，就是我其实通过一定的这个价格策略再去抢夺更多的市场份额，从而实现这个此消彼长。我其实是现在不打算这么做的，觉得我们行业这么做意义不大，我们还是各自做好各自的事为好。这是我关于当前这个公司竞争格局这个话题之下的我的一些基本看法，也说一下。
[Translator]
Translator
For the market share, which a lot of investors are concerned and have asked a lot about, we actually after experiencing the years past, we notice that under current situation, every dollar we spend there will be more job seekers and less enterprise users. The C/B ratio is currently a challenge for the platforms who is based on the supply and demand balance of both sides. From this perspective, to keep the balanced C/B ratio, we actually don't need to spend money too aggressively, and that's my view to share. In addition, to increase the dollar market share on the enterprise user side, you know, currently the overall paying desire of the enterprise are not that strong.
The best and most effective way to enlarge our enterprise market share is to start a price war. Currently it is a chance, or it is a time to do that. I'm not planning to take even more shares by lowering our price. I don't think this is a meaningful thing to do at current situation, and that's my view to share. Thank you, operator. Let's move on to the next question.
Operator
Thank you. Our next question comes from Eddy Wang with Morgan Stanley. Your line is open.
Eddy Wang
Executive Director, Morgan Stanley
Thank you, management, for taking my question. We understand that the macro situation since you know Q2 has been relatively weak. Just want to hear your view that have you witnessed an improvement in the recruitment demand in August versus June and July? How's the performance of different industries and different, you know, enterprises of different scales? Second question is, if the macro continue to be relatively weak, will we have any change in the business strategy to offset you know the macro impact? Thank you.
[Translator]
Translator
First, we cannot talk about the macro, but we can share with our own situation, which we observed from our website and app. First one is, in Q2, the overall willingness to pay from recruiters are lowering. Secondly, the blue-collar growth is still better than white collar. That one is still same. Let's further look into blue collars. There are several observations we can share with you. The first observation is that, the overall blue-collar recruitment demand reached a peak historical high in the pre-festival recruitment season. Just a fallback relatively faster in Q2.
Even relatively faster fallback in Q2, we still see a very good year-on-year growth in terms of the blue-collar revenue in Q2. Among the detailed subsectors, there is one highlight, which is the factory industry. Continue to outperform all other industries. After that is the logistics sector.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
二季度的一个我们看到的情况，另外有两个值得分享的观察，先是说这个城市的县级跟一线城市相比的话，在二三四线城市相对而言，它的招募者的增长的情况会更快一些。此外就是说有一个趋势是延续的，这个趋势在一季度的时候我们看到了，也跟大家分享过了，二季度是延续的，也就是大型企业它们的增长会更好一些。比如说一万人以上的企业，它们其实是整体保持了更快的一个招聘行为的增长。
[Translator]
Translator
There are also other two observations worth sharing. First, compared to the first tier cities, the recruiter enterprise user growth is better and faster in the second, third, and fourth tier cities. The second one is, there is a continued trend which we have already discussed in the last quarter results. That is a larger size of the enterprise grow better. For example, a big enterprise with over 10,000 employees are the companies with the fastest or the faster growth rate.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
八月份的情况我们确实也看到了。先延续一下蓝领的话题。八月份的话，蓝领的岗位的供需情况比例是好于整个Q2的情况，C/B比的改善是看得见的。B端的入驻不断地在上升当中。此外就是制造业持续表现亮眼。
[Translator]
Translator
About our recent situation in August, we continue to talk about the blue-collar. Blue-collar, the overall supply and demand situation in August is better than Q2, and the enterprise to job seeker ratio continue to see improvement. We observed the daily active enterprise user number continue to go up week by week, and the manufacturing industries are still the best among all others.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
那么您还问到关于就是我们在商业化上一个什么措施，有一些措施来对冲这个影响的话，我们其实正在做，正在做的事情是把更多资源集中在原本可能要再涨个较长时间，在我们原先的资源分配的情况下，得到的资源比较有限。比方说我们讲这个蓝领制造业，海螺，从海螺计划到海螺优选到产生收入的这个过程，我们现在正在加大投入和加快速度。
[Translator]
Translator
The second question about what kind of monetization strategy we can use to combat the macro headwinds. The things we are currently doing first is to concentrate our resources to the business and department which, because it's a slower outlook, a lot longer outlook, we give limited resources to. For example, on the blue-collar manufacturing industry, we from Hailuo Conch Project to Conch Select and to generate revenues. We are currently enhancing our investment and input on this area.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我不敢确定说我们在今年Q3、Q4就能够在海螺优选这个跟蓝领制造业进行合作的项目上有很大的收入，但是我相信这是互联网平台在介入蓝领制造业的这个游戏当中的第一次机会。一个互联网公司可以make some real money，我觉得是从这开始的，我对此信心很足。
[Translator]
Translator
I cannot be so very certain to say that the Conch Select project will have very big revenue from our cooperation with blue-collar manufacturing industry in Q3 and Q4 of this year. We believe this is the first real chance, actual chance for the online recruitment platform to go into the blue-collar manufacturing industry and make some real money.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
对，我就先回答这么多。
[Translator]
Translator
That's my answer to your question.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
谢谢。
Operator
Thank you. Our next question comes from Robin Zhu with Bernstein. Your line is open.
Robin Zhu
Senior Analyst and Managing Director, Bernstein
谢谢主持人，谢谢赵总，一个问题，那个我就问两个问题吧。一个是能不能麻烦公司详细讲讲最近我们收购了我的打工网之后的一些布局，比较细化地讲讲海外现在业务的一些发展，AI等等。另外第二个问题的话呢，就是最近公司股价也相对比较弱，我不知道就是能不能细化一下，对于股东回报这边的一些具体往前的一些考量，比如说后面三四季度回购的一个节奏，以及就是说今年会不会考虑常态化这个分红的这个一个计划。So two questions, one, would management elaborate on recent developments in the company with regards to the W.D. Technology acquisition.
you know, if management could give us more color on overseas and investments in AI. Second, given the weakness in the company shares in recent times, could management share some thoughts on going forward buybacks and whether the company will consider instituting a regular dividend? Thank you.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我的打工网成为我们公司的一部分，我们收购了它的大部分的股权。这件事情在我们的conference call上提过几次。实际上我现在就很想再强调一下，我们其实做这件事呢，归根到底它不完全是一个布局的概念，实际上是想增加一点自己的能力，增加一些我们公司自己所挺难长出来的，可能能长出来，但是有风险或者花很多时间的一个核心能力。
[Translator]
Translator
Thank you for your question. The first one on our W.D. Technology Investment Group Limited, I have mentioned that in our conference call before. Because of the Jason, the CEO is a very respectful peer of ours. Since their establishment in 2015 until now, they are being able to become the number one in their own areas. To purchase majority of the shareholder stake of W.D. Technology Investment Group Limited is out of the recognition and the respect of Jason, the CEO and his team work in this area. It's not just our further expansion into the area. It's more likely to add ourselves with some capabilities we, which is difficult for we to develop by ourselves.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
那么，Jason CEO跟他的团队在制造业蓝领这个领域所了解到的知识，所创造出来的服务模式，在整个行业都是被充分认可的。那么在现在的阶段来讲呢，他其实是，我可以给你们汇报，他其实是这么三件事，跟公司一起做。第一件事就是完全独立的，正如公司的承诺，完全独立地领导我的打工网的业务发展。
[Translator]
Translator
Jason and his team, we fully recognize his knowledge and the industry actually has fully recognized their knowledge, know-how, and model in the manufacturing industry. Currently he is working with us for three things. First of all, they are fully independently to lead the development of W.D. Technology.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
第二件事就是他其实是帮助我、帮助公司一起把海螺计划的环境优化工作和海螺优选的商业化工作能够向前推进的一个重要的建议者。
[Translator]
Translator
The second thing is to help the company to push forward the overall environment improvement under the Conch Project and the monetization commercial project, commercial plan under the Conch Select Project.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
第三件事情其实我们现在还确实是不适于公开披露。我能说的就是Jason在领导由我的打工网的运营团队和招聘的一部分产品研发团队共同组成的一个团队，试图能够把我的打工网所优势的服务领域的工作和招聘所优势的流量和推荐工作结合起来，正在推出一款我们还挺有期待的一款服务，但是现在我觉得还是先不说，我觉得也再过一个季度吧。
[Translator]
Translator
The third one, which is not suitable to discuss more details publicly at this moment, is that Jason is currently leading the operational team of W.D. Technology and part of our R&D team to together combine the advantages of our traffic and their experience and know-how in the industry to combine together to publish new product or service, we are rather looking forward to that, but maybe in the next quarter.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
我们的香港，我们的香港公司目前有一点点进展，就是我们在香港初步推出一款我们可以认为是一个MVP这样的一个服务，来看看我们香港的用户会怎么看。这件事情我觉得需要两到三个月的时间，然后我们可能要决定是不是要加快在香港业务发展的速度。如果在香港能够看得见是一个不错的收入，我觉得真正在revenue上有所贡献，我觉得今天讲为时过早。我现在来看，这是一个三年的计划。那么在亚洲和欧洲的发达国家跟地区，我们进行了比较长期的海外业务拓展的一个探索。目前我能汇报的就是我对于所招募到的当地团队，我是满意的，我也有信心。
[Translator]
Translator
For our overseas business, first for our Hong Kong initiatives, we have made some progress and have initially published an MVP service to serve the recruiters in Hong Kong and see how the users might react or behave on our platform. This might take two to three months, and then we will decide whether we can accelerate the development of this business. In terms of the revenue, a decent revenue from Hong Kong business, I think it's a little bit early, maybe take more than next two to three years. In the Asia and Europe area and some developed countries, we take quite a long time to explore.
Eddy Wang
Executive Director, Morgan Stanley
At current state, what I can say is that I'm satisfied with the local team we have recruited and we have confidence.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
您刚才提到的关于这个生成式AI领域的我们的想法，以前也在conference call上也给各位股东做过一些汇报。我今天讲一下的话就是两层意思。第一层意思就是我们会执行在科研上面的讲过多次的尾灯计划，Taillight Plan，就是我们还是希望我们的研发团队能够弄得明白全球最领先的生成式AI的人，他其实是有什么突破，但是我们没有打算花资源追上去，我们也追不上去。那么尾灯计划的本质其实是我们不打算在生成式AI训练模型上面再投入更大的资源，其实我们也投不起。
[Translator]
Translator
The third one regarding the generative AI, I have shared some of our thoughts before, and maybe add some more here. There are two points. First, in a scientific perspective, we are executing a Taillight Plan project, which is for our research guys, our tech guys to understand, to know what the most developed technology in this area is and what they are doing. But we are not planning to invest more resources. Actually we cannot afford to do that, to actually do that. We just know what they are doing and keep up with the most advanced technology.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
另外一个就是我们在应用层面坚持我们之前的一个策略，就是凡是这个生成式AI出现之前没有办法做的有价值的事，我们就会优先去考虑。那么在这个策略之下，我们现在有一些公司内部在工业上已经在应用的一些东西，我觉得就还可以。
[Translator]
Translator
On the application level, our strategy is still, if something is not happening before the emergence of generative AI technology, then we give priority to that. Under that strategy, we have some good applications in the industry level. We are using it internally now.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
关于股东回报这一块也是大家非常关心，我还是坚持我们其实从长期看，公司重视股东回报是公司经营的一个基本伦理问题，这个肯定是必须要重视，而且我们一直都很重视。那么从短期看，当前公司的核心股东和核心员工都有一个信心问题，那么这个信心其实它不是一个虚的东西，不是一个主观的东西，它其实是非常实在的一个东西。所以的话，我觉得这个当前把股东回报进一步做好，也有它的当前的必要性，这是我的一个基本观点。然后在这个观点之下呢，我们其实有一个两亿美金的回购计划，过去四个月我们做了USD 8,800万。在我们这样一个规模的公司上来看，我觉得这是公司实实在在的一个行动，而且是非常有分量的一个行动。不是用嘴说的，而是拿钱在做的。我们还会持续这个回购计划。
[Translator]
Translator
About the shareholder returns, we have long been insisting on providing shareholder return to our shareholders, which I believe is the basic ethics for the company. We always attach great importance to that. It's a very true problem, very true, very crucial point for the core shareholders and the employees to maintain our strong confidence. It's very essential and important to do a good shareholder return project. We have a $200 million share buyback program, and in the last four months we have already bought $88 million.
This is a real number and a real act we have done for a company of our size, and we will continue to do that.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
对于分红来说，公司还是在研究之中，我可以说一个可能的分红的计划。以上是我对于您的问题的回答。
[Translator]
Translator
About dividends, I can say that for potential dividend payout plan, we're still under research. That's my answer to your question. Given the time constraint, I think that that's the last question on the call. Operator.
Operator
Thank you. Due to time constraint, that concludes today's question and answer session. At this time, I'll return the conference back to Wenbei for any additional closing remarks.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Thank you once again for joining us today. If you have any further questions, please contact our IR team directly or Piacente Financial Communications. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. You may now disconnect. Good day.

content.text:
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for standing by, and welcome to the Kanzhun Limited Q1 2024 Financial Results Conference Call. At this time, all participants are in listen-only mode. After the leaders presentation, there will be a Q&A session. Today's conference is being recorded. At this time, I would like to turn the conference over to Ms. Wenbei Wang, Head of Investor Relations. Please go ahead, ma'am.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Thank you, operator. Good evening, and good morning, everyone. Welcome to our Q1 2024 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me today are our Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Mr. Jonathan Peng Zhao, and our Director and CFO, Mr. Phil Yu Zhang. Before we start, we would like to remind you that today's discussion may contain forward-looking statements, which are based on management's current expectations and observations that involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors not under the company's control, which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the company to be materially different. The company caution you not to place undue reliance on forward-looking statements and do not undertake any obligation to update this forward-looking information, except as required by law. During today's call, management will also discuss certain non-GAAP financial measures for comparison purpose only.
For definition of non-GAAP financial measures and the reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial results, please see the earnings release issued earlier today. In addition, a webcast replay of this conference call will be available on our website at ir.zhipin.com. That said, I will now turn the call to Jonathan, our Founder, Chairman, and CEO.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]大家好，欢迎参加我们公司二零二四年一季度业绩发布会。我代表公司全体员工、管理层和董事会感谢一直相信我们、支持我们的用户和投资人。
[Translator]
Translator
Hello, everyone. Welcome to our company's Q1 2024 Earnings Conference Call. On behalf of the company's employees, management team, and board of directors, I would like to thank our users and investors who have always believed in us and supported us.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]先介绍一下业绩的情况。一季度公司实现经计算现金收款20.5亿元，同比增长24%，环比增长15%。GAAP收入17.04亿元，同比增长33%，环比增长8%。一季度实现2.4亿元的净利润，同时扣除股权激励费用后，经调整的净利润为5.3亿元，同比增长117%。
[Translator]
Translator
Let me first introduce our financial performance. In Q1, the company achieved calculated cash billings of RMB 2.05 billion, up 24% year-on-year, and 15% quarter-on-quarter. Our GAAP revenue reached RMB 1.7 billion, up 33% year-on-year, and 8% quarter-on-quarter. We achieved a net profit of RMB 240 million. Meanwhile, our adjusted net income, which excludes share-based compensation expenses, was RMB 530 million, up 117% year-on-year.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]一季度BOSS直聘APP端的平均完善MAU达到4,662万，同比增长17%。与去年同期相比，今年的企业端用户的增长更快。
[Translator]
Translator
In Q1, the average verified MAU on the BOSS Zhipin app reached 46.62 million, representing a 17% year-on-year growth. The growth rate of enterprise users is faster this quarter compared with the same period last year.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]三月份BOSS直聘APP端的完善月活用户首次超过五千万，达到五千五百万，同比增长24%。同时，DAU占MAU的比例依然稳定
[Translator]
Translator
In March, the number of verified MAU on the BOSS Zhipin app exceeded 50 million for the first time, reaching 55 million, up 24% year-on-year. At the same time, the ratio of DAU to MAU remains stable.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]今年一到四月份，公司新增完善用户超过1,700万。截止到四月底，平台累计服务的完善用户数已经超过1.9亿，累计服务的企业用户超过1,400万家。
[Translator]
Translator
As of the end of April, the cumulative number of verified users served by our platform exceeded 190 million, with the cumulative number of verified enterprises surpassing 40 million, which means from January to April this year, the company attracted more than 17 million newly added verified users.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]截止到2024年3月31号，公司在有大约570万个招聘者，分布在超过350万个企业当中，他们在BOSS直聘付费开展招聘活动。
[Translator]
Translator
As of 31 March 2024, approximately 5.7 million enterprise customers across more than 3.5 million enterprises conducted paid recruitment activities on BOSS Zhipin during the past trailing 12 months.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]所以在十二个月当中，在BOSS直聘付费的企业数量超过350万家公司，这在全球的企业服务市场中看起来都很大，甚至于超过许多国家的人口总数。但是在中国整体超过4000万的企业规模当中，占比不足10%。所以中国的在线招聘服务的年度付费的企业数量在未来仍然有巨大的增长空间。
[Translator]
Translator
In 12 months, there are more than 350 million companies paid for our service. This number seems very large in terms of the global enterprise service market. It even exceeds the total population of some countries. However, it only represents less than 10% of China's over 40 million enterprises. Which means there is enormous growth potential in the number of paying companies for China's online recruitment service in the future.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]而且很容易看到，平均每一个企业年度付费不超过RMB两千元。随着广大的中国公司对于有价值的刚需性的To B服务的付费意愿逐步提升，这一局面也会不断地得到改观，ARPU也会逐渐地增加。
[Translator]
Translator
Furthermore, it is obvious to calculate that the average annual payment per enterprise is currently less than RMB 2,000. As the vast pool of Chinese enterprises gradually becomes more willing to pay for valuable and must-have B2B services, the situation will continue to improve, which means ARPU will continue to rise.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]因此，对于BOSS直聘来说，乃至于对于整个中国的在线招聘行业来说，不论是付费企业的数量，还是付费企业的ARPU，在未来都有很大的增长空间。
[Translator]
Translator
Therefore, for BOSS, both BOSS Zhipin and the entire online recruitment industry in China, we see significant growth potential in both the number of paying enterprises and their ARPU.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]在上次的业绩会上，我们分享了几个今年春招的特点，现在我们也补充一些最近更新的趋势。
[Translator]
Translator
In our last earnings call, we shared some characteristics of this year's spring recruitment season. Today, we would like to provide additional insights and updates on recent trends.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]好，首先仍然介绍一下蓝领。蓝领用户和收入规模保持持续的快速增长。一季度我们的新增用户当中，蓝领用户从绝对值到增速都已经超过白领。蓝领的收入占比也提升到超过了35%。
[Translator]
Translator
First, still, the blue-collar segment. The number of blue-collar users and this segment's revenue continue to grow rapidly. Among new users in Q1, both the absolute amount and the growth rate of blue-collar users surpassed that of the white-collar users, with the blue-collar users' revenue contribution climbing up to over 35%.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]值得一提的是，相比去年，今年的制造业和物流行业景气度明显提升，并且保持稳定上涨的趋势。春节之后到五月中，制造和物流行业日均的新增职位数量比去年同期增长了约40%左右。同时白领的情况也比去年同期有所改善。
[Translator]
Translator
It's worth mentioning that compared with last year, the manufacturing and logistics industries have seen a good improvement in business sentiment this year, maintaining a steady upward trend. From the post-Spring Festival to mid-May, the number of daily average newly added job positions in manufacturing and logistics industries increased by approximately 40% compared with the same period last year. At the same time, the white-collar sector has also shown some improvement trend.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]然后看一下企业规模。随着整个白领行业景气度复苏的带动，大企业的招聘需求在同比增长上要好于小企业，呈现出进一步的恢复。
[Translator]
Translator
The second trend relates to enterprise size. Driven by the recovery in the white-collar sector, the large company's recruitment demand has increased better year-on-year compared to that of smaller enterprises, showing the further recovery.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]第三，看一下城市的维度。二线及二线以下城市，在用户增长和收入占比的增长上都在持续地提高。与此同时，看同比走势的话，今年一线城市的招聘需求亦有所恢复。
[Translator]
Translator
The third one is by city tiers. Second-tier and lower-tier cities have showed continued increase in both user growth and revenue contribution. However, the recruitment demand from first-tier cities has also recovered to some degree this year compared to the same period last year.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]在生产制造、供应链物流、互联网、AI技术、金融、采购贸易等等是近期走势相对更好一些的细分行业。
[Translator]
Translator
Manufacturing, supply chain logistics, internet, AI technology, finance, and procurement trade subsectors have shown relatively better growth momentum recently.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]大家可能也已经注意到了，我们近期收购了国内领先的制造业工人的一个人才交付服务平台，叫做我的打工网。

BOSS, we started as white-collar platform focusing on internet technology companies, and WD, they focused and started with manufacturing factory workers. I have known WD for quite a long time. My definition for them is actually they are survivor lucky guy.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]他们率先创造了一些适合数字能力和中国的工厂能够相结合的一些做法，他率先进行了一些创造。比如说，最早围绕用户以这个求职者为核心来打造整个的体验过程，其实是他最早做的，而且坚持到今天，这也构成了他为什么能够在这么多的制造业的这个中介机构当中能够独树一帜，做到老大，地区的老大，地区的老大，我觉得也是体现了他的这种创造精神。
[Translator]
Translator
WD, they are the pioneer in inventing some capability which is suitable for digitalization, which combined with manufacturing, related recruitment. For example, they are one of the first to concentrate or prioritize the user experience of the job seekers and for the users, helping improve their user experience. That's why today they can be the leading platforms for certain regions.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]所以BOSS直聘在第一次披露这个并购的案子，我也想顺便说我们在并购当中，其实我们最关心的是我们通过并购获得一个自己积累起来非常难，甚至于，啊，敬畏一点讲吧，自己未必能积累的一个核心能力，我们通过并购的方法来获得，将会有利于整个公司少走弯路，能够站在巨人的肩膀上把事做好。
[Translator]
Translator
This is the first time Boss have to discuss about our acquisition. I will also want to share that our acquisition strategy is we want to acquire some core abilities respectfully, which cannot be accumulated by our own, and that will help us to cut the chase and work together to achieve better results.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]所以这个是我介绍一下我们跟我的打工网合作的一些考虑，供您参考。
[Translator]
Translator
That's our consideration for our collaboration with WD, [Foreign language]我的打工网 for your reference.
Phil Yu Zhang
Director and CFO, Kanzhun
Well, I can comment, Timothy's second question regarding the user growth and the marketing strategy. Basically, we will keep marketing expenses at a reasonable level and maintain a disciplined user growth approach. This is what we mentioned many, many times. Definitely we would like to leverage the Paris Olympic Games to enhance our brand. But we will have to spend appropriately within current market environments. Leading platforms like us, we believe, enjoy higher economies of scale and have a better marketing efficiency, which means without heightened spending, our user growth is still satisfactory. Our new user growth totaled 17 million in the first four months this year, close to half of our annual target of 30-40 million new users. With this situation, we don't need to be extra aggressive at this front. I hope my comment answers your question.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Okay, that's our, all of our answers, and operator, let's move on to next question.
Operator
Thank you. Please stand by. Our next question comes from the line of Yang Bai from CICC. Please go ahead. Your line is open.
Yang Bai
Executive Director, CICC
[Foreign language]谢谢王立总。我有两个问题。第一个问题想问一下，在春招之后，我们有看到竞争格局是否发生了一些什么样的变化。那第二个问题是想问一下，就刚才其实也提到今年的市场投放的策略，我们也注意到，互联网行业今年各大公司都加大了在AI相关的这个CapEx支出，包括咱们公司自己的AI相关费用也有所增加。那么，我们对今年后续利润率的展望是否会有所调整？I will translate for myself.
The first one is, have we seen any change in the competitive landscape after the spring recruitment? The second one is, we have mentioned the sales and marketing strategies for this year before. We also notice that internet companies are increasing their AI CapEx, including our AI related expenses. Have we adjusted our outlook on profit margin this year? Thank you.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]今年春天，我们注意到主要的同行在市场投放上面，大部分人有比较大的投放，花了比较多的钱。这是我们注意到的，我们买位置的时候竞争是比较激烈的。所以看到这一点就是，花钱的时候，大家的兴奋程度提高了。我们上一个季度开会的时候，我其实还分析过为什么。因为说实话，我觉得今年大家应该看到收入都是有机会的，所以的话就会愿意花更多的钱。这是我要讲的第一个意思。
[Translator]
Translator
Thank you for your question. For the first one regarding competition, this year we have noticed this spring many of our peers or majority of them have spending more aggressively this year during the spring recruitment season. We noticed that when we was also doing the same marketing investment, so the competition is more fierce. The overall spending has increased a lot. During the last earnings call, I have also analyzed why, because this year people feel that there is opportunity in the market, and they would like to spend more to increase their revenue.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]接下来就是说，经过了第一季度，经过了一季度的在marketing上面的这个争夺，迄今我们看到四月份的第三方的数据，援引一个其实你们大家也都在用的一个数据看，我们的竞争格局依然保持稳定，乃至于有些数据还会之前没有超过，有些个别的口径上没有超过某些同行。那么四月份应该是我们全面的超过并占据了行业领先的位置。
[Translator]
Translator
After the completion of marketing in the first quarter. I think you have all already noticed that the third-party data is in April. The overall competitive landscape is very stable. Some operating metrics in the past, we are still maybe a little bit below our peers. In April, we have surpassed all of our competitors in all operating metrics.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]所以，总结一季度的竞争格局的话，我感觉到依旧是我们其实非常重视，迄今来自行业竞争对手的积极的行为。与此同时，我们坚定地认为，把C端的用户和B端的用户服务好，提供最好的产品和服务，仍然是非常有效的和甚至于唯一有效的marketing手段，加一个引号的marketing。
[Translator]
Translator
To conclude on the Q1 competitive situation that we very value, highly respect our peers active marketing events. We firmly believe that to continue to improve our service for both job seekers and recruiters is still the effective or maybe the only effective way in terms of quote unquote marketing strategies.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]那么numbers的总结上就是在MAU、在DAU、在用户活跃度、用户时长等等维度上来讲，仍然保持着好的趋势和相对的领先优势。以上是对于竞争格局的看法。
[Translator]
Translator
Our numbers of both MAU, DAU activities, and user time spend, and all the operating metrics, we continue to maintain good momentum and advantages. That's my answer for the competitive question.
Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
Regarding your second question related to our margin profile for the full year. I could quickly run through the major cost and the expenses item and mention our thoughts. Regarding the gross margin. Basically the line below the COGS.
Phil Yu Zhang
Director and CFO, Kanzhun
Gross margin, we think that will slightly improve due to a higher economy of scale, starting from Q2. Mainly, marketing expenses, we think will maintain at a current level. Absolute amount will increase a little bit. Percentage rise will be flat or decline. In terms of the selling expense, which is mainly compensation of sales guys, its percentage to revenue will be flat or decline. Combined, the selling and the marketing expenses, the total selling and marketing expense, its total percentage points to revenue will further improve in 2024. R&D expenses, which is related to you just mentioned AI, spending.
You're right that we increase our investment related to the AI and but that part could be offset by the revenue in the full year. The full year percentage-wise R&D expense would be flat, similar percentage points compared to last year. Then, G&A percentage to revenue for full year will be improved compared with last year. In Q1, temporarily, it's increased, but we expect the Q2 will drop. The full year percentage-wise will be better compared with last year. The trend I just mentioned fits both for our GAAP numbers and our adjusted non-GAAP numbers. All in all, our operating margin in 2024 would like to improve along with our continued revenue growth.
That's my comment on the major cost items and the overall margin for the company.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
That's all of our answer to the question. Operator, please go ahead.
Operator
Due to time constraints, that concludes today's question and answer session. At this time, I will turn the conference back to Wenbei for any additional or closing remarks.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Thank you once again for joining us today. If you have any further questions, please contact our IR director directly. Thank you.
Operator
This concludes today's conference call. Thank you for participating. You may now disconnect. Speakers, please stand by.

content.text:
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for standing by. Welcome to the Kanzhun Limited Q4 and Fiscal Year 2023 Financial Results Conference Call. At this time, all participants are in a listen-only mode. After the speaker's presentation, there will be a question-and-answer session. Today's conference is being recorded. At this time, I would like to turn the conference over to Ms. Wang, Wenbei Wang, Head of Investor Relations. Please go ahead, ma'am.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Thank you, operator. Good evening, and good morning, everyone. Welcome to our Q4 and full-year 2023 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me today are our Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Mr. Jonathan Peng Zhao, and our Director and CFO, Mr. Phil Yu Zhang.
Before we start, we would like to remind you that today's discussion may contain forward-looking statements, which are based on management's current expectations and observations that involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and other factors not under the company's control, which may cause actual results, performance, or achievements of the company to be materially different.
The company cautions you not to place undue reliance on forward-looking statements and does not undertake any obligation to update this forward-looking information, except as required by law. During today's call, management will also discuss certain non-GAAP financial measures for comparison purposes only.
For a definition of non-GAAP financial measures and the reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial results, please see the earnings release issued earlier today. In addition, a webcast replay of this conference call will be available on our website at ir.zhipin.com. With that, I will now turn the call to Jonathan, our founder, Chairman, and CEO.
Hello, everyone. Welcome to our Q4 and full-year 2023 Earnings Conference Call. On behalf of the company and our employees, management team, and the board of directors, I would like to express our sincere gratitude to our investors who trust and support us.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 先介绍一下2023年四季度的业绩情况。四季度公司实现经计算现金收款17.8亿元，同比增长61%，环比增长9%。GAAP收入15.8亿元，同比增长46%，环比基本持平。扣除股权激励费用后，经调整的净利润为6.3亿元。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
First, I would like to share our performance with you. In the Q4, the company achieved a calculated cash billings of RMB 1.78 billion, up 61% year-on-year and 9% quarter-on-quarter. Our GAAP revenue reached RMB 1.58 billion, up 46% year-on-year and remained flattish with last quarter. Our adjusted net income, which excludes share-based compensation expenses, was RMB 630 million.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 四季度，BOSS直聘APP端平均完善MAU为4,120万，同比增长33%。四季度我们观察到招聘者与求职者的供需比例关系在好转。我们观察到中大型企业持续了三季度以来稳步复苏的表现，这些都有利于我们在四季度的现金收款、GAAP收入和利润水平都超过了我们的预期。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
In Q4, the average verified MAU on the BOSS Zhipin app reached 41.2 million, representing a 33% year-on-year increase. In Q4, we noted an improving ratio between the demands from active enterprise users and the supplies from job seekers. We also noted continued steady recovery of medium and large-scale enterprises since Q3, all of which contributing to our cash billings, GAAP revenues, and profit levels in Q4 to exceed our expectations.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 看一下2023年全年的情况。公司实现经计算现金收款66.9亿元，同比增长45%。实现收入59.5亿元，同比增长32%。扣除股权激励费用后，全年经调整的净利润为21.6亿元。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Let's take a look for the full year of 2023. The company achieved a calculated cash billing of RMB 6.65 billion, up by 45% year-on-year, and a GAAP revenue of RMB 5.95 billion, up by 32% year-on-year. Excluding share-based compensation expenses, the adjusted net income for the year reached RMB 2.16 billion.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 不考虑理财收益等等其他收益，2023年经调整后的营业利润为16.4亿元，同比增长191%，对应27.5%的经调整后的营业利润率。这展现了公司的盈利能力。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Furthermore, excluding other income such as wealth management income, the adjusted operating income for 2023 was RMB 1.64 billion, reflecting a remarkable 191% year-on-year increase. This resulted in a 27.5% adjusted operating margin, underscoring the company's robust profitability capability.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 2023年年度，我们新增完善的用户超过4,900万人，是公司自成立以来新增用户规模最大的一年。这一年我们所服务的用户增加了接近二分之一亿，我们能够帮助到他们用我们的产品，对此我们深感自豪。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
In 2023, we attracted more than 49 million newly added verified users, representing the largest annual growth in user base since the company's inception. This year, the number of users we serve has increased by nearly 50 million, and we are able to help them with our products, which we are deeply proud of.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 截止到12月31号，公司已经累计服务超过1.78亿的用户和1,330万家企业，全年在APP端的平均月活规模是4,227万，同比增长了47%。全年有将近15亿人次的用户在平台上实现了BC双边的达成。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
As of 31 December 2023, the company has served a total of over 178 million individual users and 13.3 million enterprises. The average verified MAU on the BOSS Zhipin app was 42.27 million in 2023, representing a year-on-year increase of 47%. Approximately 1.5 billion mutual achievements between job seekers and recruiters have been accomplished on our platform throughout the year.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language]2023年付费企业端的客户数是520万，同比增长了44%。付费的用户数，活跃用户的付费率的水平持续创历史新高。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
In 2023, the number of paid enterprise customers increased by 44% year-on-year to 5.2 million. Moreover, both the number of paid enterprise users and the paying ratio of active users continued to achieve record highs.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 随着用户覆盖的提升，公司的用户和收入的结构也在发生了一些变化。重点体现在这几个方面。第一，蓝领用户在2023年的新增用户规模已经与白领用户相当，收入贡献超过了34%。第二，二线及二线以下城市的收入贡献超过了60%，同比提升了五个点。第三，小于一百人的小微企业的收入贡献同比提升也超过了五个百分点。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
As the company continues to expand our user coverage, both the user and revenue structure undergoes constant evolution, highlighted by the following key points. First, in 2023, the scale of newly added blue-collar users matched that of the white-collar users, with revenue contribution of the whole year from blue-collar users exceeding 34%.
Second, revenue contribution from second and lower-tier cities exceeded 60%, a 5 percentage point increase year-on-year. Third, revenue contribution from enterprises with less than 100 employees also increased by more than 5 percentage points year-on-year.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 这些变化进一步让我们有信心，感到我们的产品是可以服务不同的用户，以及我们的revenue model也适应于不同的用户。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
All these changes further demonstrated that we are confident that our product can serve different users and also our service can cover different kind of users.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 这主要还是基于我们一直在深入研究不同用户的细致的具体需求，以及我们一直在不断地加大技术的投入。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
This is mainly based on the down-to-earth research on actual detailed needs, from different kind of users and our continuous efforts in technology investments.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 今年一月，公司自主研发的首个招聘行业的垂类大语言模型，我们把它叫做南北阁大语言模型，通过了生成式人工智能服务的算法备案。模型的效果在一些公开的benchmark上达到了业界的领先水平，并且也逐步在招聘端和求职者端尝试一些落地应用。比如说帮助刚刚创业的小白用户快速发布职位，比如说帮助职场经验不足的年轻人来做好自己的一个简历等等。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
In January this year, our company's proprietary big model, which we named it Nanbeige big Large Language Model, which is believed to be the first large language model designed specifically for the recruitment industry, has successfully completed its online registration for generative artificial intelligence.
The effect of this model has reached the industry-leading level on some public benchmarks and has gradually been applied in some recruiting and job-seeking scenarios. For example, for those young entrepreneurs who are starting up their companies, we provide them with rapid job posting function. For those young people or fresh graduate job seekers, we provide them with resume polishing functions, etc.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 公司在AIGC的投入主要有两个原则。第一就是追踪先进的技术，避免出现在技术认知上的代际的差异。第二，我们还是更看重在工业上的落地，不会去做盲目的大投入。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
The company's investment in AIGC mainly focus on two principles. First, we keep track of the cutting-edge technology to avoid the generational gaps in knowledge. Second, focus on industrial implementation and not make big investment blindly.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 接下来我们简单更新一下今年春节的情况。今年春节之后，公司的各项数据持续创造历史新高，比如APP端的DAU接近1,700万。这其中也表现出了一些与去年同期不同的特点，有如下几个关键点。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Next, we will briefly update the situation for this spring. Following the Spring Festival, the company's various user metrics continued to hit historical heights, with the peak DAU on the BOSS Zhipin app approaching 17 million, for example. From those data, we also identified several characteristics which are notably different from the same period last year, including the following keywords.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 第一个关键词是招聘者。春节后到现在的日均的新增职位数、在线的职位数均创下历史同期的新高。日均在线的职位数同比增长约20%。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
First, recruiters. Since the Spring Festival, the daily average number of newly posted job positions and active job positions have both reached historical highs compared with the same period in the previous years. The daily average number of active job positions increased by 20% year-on-year.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 第二个关键词是大企业，比方一万人以上的大企业，在春节之后到现在，日均的在线职位同比2023年同期增长24%。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
The second keyword is large enterprises. Since Spring Festival, the average daily active position from enterprises with more than 10,000 employees increased by 24% compared with the same period of 2023.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 第三个关键字是说行业。今年春节之后到现在，所有行业的日均新增和在线的职位相比2023年同比同期都呈现了一个正增长，其中蓝领由服务业领跑，继续创新高。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
The third keyword is industry. The daily average number of newly added job positions and active job positions across all industries has shown positive growth since this year's Spring Festival compared with the same period of 2023. Among which the blue-collar industry has once again reached a new year high, driven by the continuous expansion of urban service sectors.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 另外，机械制造和交通物流的同比增长都在加速。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Additionally, the manufacturing and supply chain logistics sector has shown accelerated year-on-year growth rate.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 相对白领来看，消费品、医疗器械、汽车广告等行业的涨幅相对靠前。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Within the white-collar industry, sectors such as consumer goods, medical equipment, automotive, and advertising media are leading the growth.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 第四个关键字是商业。我们从职位的类型来看，跟去年不同的是，聚焦在企业要发展业务，要雇更多的人来发展业务这件事情上，看销售类的职位，然后人力资源服务类的职位，财务类的职位等等的职位增速都有明显的回升。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
The fourth keyword is business. There has been a noticeable shift in the types of job positions compared with last year. The positions focusing on the development and growth of the enterprise business such as sales guys, human resource services, finance, and related positions have experienced a clear rebound in growth rates.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 因此我们预期的话，一季度的公司的现金收款和收入都还会有不错的一个环比增长。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
We anticipate our quarter-on-quarter increase in both cash billings and revenue for Q1.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 今天公司董事会批准了新的一期的股票回购计划，并且把回购的额度上调到在未来十二个月回购最多两亿美元的公司股票。这是我们第三个股票回购计划，加上去年十一月我们发放的八千万美元的特殊现金股息，这证明了管理层对长期回报股东的态度和诚意。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
I'm pleased to announce the company's board of directors approved a new share repurchase plan today, upsizing to repurchase up to $200 million of the company's shares over the next 12 months. This marks our third share repurchase plan alongside the $80 million special cash dividend issued in last November, demonstrating the management's commitment and sincerity towards long-term shareholder returns.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 我的部分就介绍到这里，接下来由我们的CFO Phil为大家介绍我们的财务情况。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
That concluded my part of the call. I will now turn it over to our CFO, Phil, for the review of our financials. Thank you.
Phil Yu Zhang
Director and CFO, Kanzhun
Thanks, Jonathan. Hello, everyone. Now let me walk through the details of our financial results of Q4 and full year 2023. We are pleased to deliver a strong set of results for Q4 and the full year 2023. For Q4, our calculated cash billings reached a historical high of RMB 1.8 billion, grew by 61% year-over-year, and notably 9% quarter-on-quarter, beating our expectations.

The top priority will always be we will use our money for future development, for user growth, to expand our advanced model to more user groups, to more industries, areas, and countries, to initiate our business.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 现金可以用来回报股东的方式还包括，我们目前正在研究的就是，去年十二月我们首次进行了现金分红，目前我们正在研究、正在推进未来一种可持续的派息可能性的方案。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
The second priority to provide shareholder return we are currently exploring a possibility, following our initial special cash dividend last year, to pay cash dividend continuously in the future.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 从回购的角度来讲，我们今天的董事会通过了一个两亿美金的回购计划。这个也是我们一直在做的事情，通过股票回购的方式，可以使得整个我们的股东方所持有的公司的比例能够得到一定的保障。综上的几种方式，我觉得它是一个统筹调配的过程，我们会把这件事情继续开展。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
The last one is from share repurchase perspective. We just approved this $200 million new repurchase program. That's what we have been doing, and we are committed to do. We want to utilize this share buyback program to guarantee our shareholders their shareholding percentage. We will in the future coordinate between all these several methods or several ways to provide the best return to our shareholders.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 然后在AI的这个角度，您也提到了，就是我们会做一些投入，然后我们的policy，我们想得比较清楚，就是第一还是说要追踪先进技术、先进的团队，不要在这一轮的AIGC的发展当中，不要出现认知上的跟第一梯队的代际上的差别。那么第二来讲，我们更多还是希望能够在工业上落地，而不是盲目地做这个大投入，跟别人去烧芯片、烧电力。说实话，这个东西我们烧不过的，所以我们应该是聪明地花钱在AI上。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
From the AI investment, our policy, like we just discussed, first is to keep up with the latest leading technology and teams to avoid any knowledge gap, generational gap compared with the first-tier teams. Secondly, we will continue to pursue the industrial implementation and not to blindly invest to compete with chips, compete with spending on electricity power, which is not worthwhile. We will spend our money cleverly.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 当然，我觉得我们的投资人、我们的股东都会关心，就是整个这一波的大模型的开发应用对于我们公司乃至于整个行业的机会，我觉得大家都很关心。我说一个我迄今为止的一个在我们在工业上的一个认知，我这个认知……
[Foreign language] 希望分享给大家。我们是这么看的，如果这件事情离开这波AI就没法办了，那说明这件事情应该投入用AI去办。如果这件事情离开这波AI一样能办，我觉得这个地方要慎重。所以我们大概是如此来进行区分，这确实是我们工业上，是不是花这个推理费用的话，我们的一个区隔，我也跟您分享一下我们的看法。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Regarding the opportunity that AI have brought about for our company and for our industry, I would like to share with you of one of my understandings, which is, if development cannot proceed without artificial intelligence, without AI, then we need to invest that. If something can function quite well even without AI, then we should be very cautious on the investment. That's a distinction between whether we should spend more from an industrial perspective.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 然后在您所关心的以及很多投资人关心的这个国际化的业务上，我们的policy也比较清楚。第一呢，我是要去赚钱，第二呢，我们这门生意呢，应该是去赚有钱人的钱。第三来讲呢，因为我们这门生意涉及到求职者的权益、劳工法等等，这个法律上的要求是比较高的。那么综上所述呢，我觉得我们应该投资于全球GDP前五、前六这样的地方，同时也是整个法律环境比较清晰透明的地方，同时也是企业付费习惯比较好的地方，同时也是古代的求职招聘模式比较赚钱的地方。综上，我觉得就是我们搞国际化是一个比较简单的去成熟市场，古代玩家法律完备，有钱的地方去，去赚一波钱。我大概就是这么想。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
About the overseas business, which many investors may concern, our policies are also quite clear. First, we will go overseas to make money. Second, we want to make money from wealthy people. Third, the recruitment and job-seeking business is quite serious regarding the power and protection of job seekers.
We have a quite high requirement for the local labor law. Fourth, based on those requirements and considerations, we will invest in the top like five or six GDP countries or areas where the legal environment are quite clear and mature, and the enterprises are used to pay for services, and all those traditional business models can make good money. That's quite clear. We all go to mature market, giant players, good laws, and wealthy people. That's our strategies for overseas business.
Jonathan Peng Zhao
Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Kanzhun
[Foreign language] 以上，以上供您参考。
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
For your reference, that wraps up our answers for those questions. Due to the time constraint, that will be the last question. Operator.
Operator
Thank you. At this time, I will turn the conference back to Wenbei for any additional or closing remarks.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Okay. Thank you once again for joining us today. If you have any further questions, please contact our team directly. Thank you.
Operator
That does conclude today's conference call. Thank you for participating. You may now disconnect your line.
Wenbei Wang
Head of Investor Relations, Kanzhun
Thank you. Bye-bye.
